programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk and the television star / Mr. Monk und der Fernsehstar
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. programme.title: Shameless
programme.desc: Frank Gallagher lives together with his six children as a single father. However, he spends most of the time in the bar and gives the little money to the family, instead of eating for alcohol for food. His oldest daughter Fiona is inevitably overturning the mother role for her siblings: the intelligent but petty criminal lip, Ian, who hides his homosexuality, the responsible but fragile debbie, the 10-year violent Carl and the little Liam. Together, despite their impossible father, the children try to master their lives on creative, scandalosis, but also warmly. / Frank Gallagher lebt als alleinerziehender Vater mit seinen sechs Kindern zusammen. Allerdings verbringt er die meiste Zeit in der Bar und gibt das wenige Geld, das der Familie zur Verfugung steht, statt fur Essen lieber fur Alkohol aus. Seine alteste Tochter Fiona ubernimmt notgedrungen die Mutterrolle fur ihre Geschwister: den intelligenten aber kleinkriminellen Lip, Ian, der seine Homosexualitat verbirgt, die verantwortungsbewusste aber fragile Debbie, den 10-jahrigen gewalttatigen Carl und den kleinen Liam. Gemeinsam versuchen die Kinder, trotz ihres unmoglichen Vaters ihr Leben auf kreative, skandalose, aber auch warmherzige Weise zu meistern.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Fudbal - Prijateljska utakmica
programme.desc: Through the long history of football football, the national team always had a special charm with players and fans, whether it was official or friendly matches. International friendly football matches are a great opportunity for menus and federations to take advantage of free representative terms without official teams to gather the teams and play different tactical ideas. programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Basketball - Serbian League / Košarka - Srpska liga
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

When the first season of the Netherlands' first season was played. In 1903. Today's structure was formed with the first edition of "World Series". The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 matches. Out of a total of eight teams that select the Plejof two best play "World Series Final". The winner is the one who arrives first to four victories in the series. / MLB ili "Major League Baseball" je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem "World Seriesa". Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Boks
programme.desc: Rocky Marciano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Louis. Do you need another reason to follow this noble martial skill? Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Rocky Marciano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Louis. programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: I am… / Аз съм…
programme.desc: "I am" is a short portrait form that presents interesting and talented young people who appear in different fields - athletes, artists, artists, singers. The purpose of the section is to promote the achievements of the young and active part of our society. / "Аз съм" е кратка портретна форма, която представя интересни и талантливи млади хора, изявяващи се в различни области – спортисти, артисти, художници, певци. Целта на рубриката е да популяризира постиженията на младата и активна част от нашето общество.

programme.title: Judo: World Cup: Finals / Джудо: Световно първенство: финали
programme.desc: The event is one of the most prestigious competitions in the sport, organized by the International Judo Federation (IJF). It brings together the best Judians from all over the world to compete for the world champion in different categories. The first World Cup was held in 1956. / Събитието е едно от най-престижните състезания в спорта, което се организира от Международната федерация по джудо (IJF). То събира най-добрите джудисти от цял свят, които се състезават за титлата световен шампион в различни категории. Първото световно първенство се провежда през 1956 година.

programme.title: Modern Pentel World Championship: semifinals /men / / Световно първенство по модерен петобой: Полуфинали /мъже/
programme.desc: The winners of the race qualify for the Olympics. / Победителите от състезанието се класират за Олимпийските игри.

programme.title: Football: World Club Championship: Esigenator: Benfica - Chelsea / Футбол: Световно клубно първенство: Осминафинал: Бенфика - Челси
programme.desc: The World Cup Championship is a world championship starring the championship clubs on the 6 continental confederations. / Световното клубно първенство по футбол е световен шампионат, в който вземат участие клубовете-шампиони на 6-те континентални конфедерации.

programme.title: Sports news / Спортни новини
programme.desc: Sports news from Bulgaria and the world. / Спортни новини от България и света.

programme.title: UEFA European qualifications for the World Cup / УЕФА Европейски квалификации за световно първенство
Cycling: A Czech Tour / Колоездене: Обиколка на Чехия
programme.desc: The Sazka Tour is one of the most famous cycling competitions in the Czech Republic, which is usually held every year in the summer and attracts participants from all over the world. The event is part of the UCI Europe Tour, which makes it meaningful for professional cyclists, as well as for lovers who want to test their skills in this picturesque country. / "Sazka Tour" е едно от най-известните колоездачни състезания в Чехия, което обикновено се провежда всяка година през лятото и привлича участници от цял свят. Събитието е част от UCI Europe Tour, което го прави значимо за професионалните колоездачи, както и за любителите, които искат да изпитат своите умения в тази живописна страна.

programme.title: Land / Проект "Земя"
programme.desc: Review of geo -engineering projects presented so far: combating air pollution, global warming, carbon dioxide emissions focus the interest of scientists who look at all options that can save us from problems. / Преглед на геоинженерните проекти, представени досега: борбата със замърсяването на въздуха, глобалното затопляне, емисиите въглероден двуокис фокусират интереса на учените, които разглеждат всички варианти, които могат да ни спасят от проблемите.

programme.title: The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: Land / Проект "Земя"
programme.desc: 2p.: Packaging of Greenland: High -tech matter covers huge ice spaces. Will the reflective coating stop the melting of the glaciers and will it eliminate the threat of floods? Geo -engineers are making a real campaign against global warming in the icy abyss of Greenland. / 2еп.: Опаковането на Гренландия: Високотехнологична материя покрива огромни ледени пространства. Дали светлоотразяващото покритие ще спре топенето на ледниците и дали ще премахне заплахата от наводнения? Геоинженерите предприемат истински поход срещу глобалното затопляне в ледената бездна на Гренландия.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Stoicho Mladenov / Зала на славата: Стойчо Младенов
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Football: World Club Championship: Esigentefinal: Paris Saint Jarmen - Inter /Miami / / Футбол: Световно клубно първенство: Осминафинал: Пари Сен Жармен - Интер /Маями/
programme.desc: The World Cup Championship is a world championship starring the championship clubs on the 6 continental confederations. / Световното клубно първенство по футбол е световен шампионат, в който вземат участие клубовете-шампиони на 6-те континентални конфедерации.

programme.title: Black space / Черно пространство
programme.desc: Eran's father is mayor and warns his son to be careful about what kind of friends he communicates. Investigator David meets Eran and realizes that he is not at school. He is lying to him for temperature. As he takes him home, they talk. Chino warns David that on the news, he was shown how the father of one of the children he investigated was beaten. In fact, he defended the son from the aggressive father. They remove it. Eran tells the Unicorn that Davidi saw him in Dor's house. So he proposes to kill him, but unicorn refuses and only advises him to get rid of the gun. Davidi realizes that Itamar is sleeping in the pizzeria because he is afraid of his father. He once saved him from his drunken father. And now he takes the boy to his home. His wife, Miri, worries that Davidi is beginning to lose control. / Бащата на Еран е кмет и предупреждава сина си да внимава с какви приятели общува. Следовател Давиди среща Еран и разбира, че не е на училище. Той го лъже, че е с температура. Докато го откарва вкъщи, разговарят. Чино предупреждава Давиди, че по новините са го показали как бие бащата на едно от децата, които разследва. А всъщност той е защитавал сина от агресивния баща. Отстраняват го. Еран казва на Еднорога, че Давиди го е видял в къщата на Дор. Затова предлага да го убият, но Еднорога отказва и го съветва само да се отърве от пистолета. Давиди разбира, че Итамар спи в пицарията, защото се страхува от баща си. Веднъж вече го е спасявал от пияния му баща. А сега завежда момчето в дома си. Съпругата му Мири се тревожи, че Давиди започва да губи контрол.

programme.title: Black space / Черно пространство
programme.desc: Another death is added to the investigation. But whether it is a suicide or an accident, they do not know. They allow an overdose that made the boy drowned. But he was a swimmer. There were antidepressants and a cure for hallucinations in his blood. The family refuses an autopsy. Natalie and Guy believe that Tom has escaped because of the three who were in the hallway one is dead, she is forever in a stroller, only he remains. His mother is desperate and regrets that she was blind to his depression, anxiety and loneliness. Miri goes to the hospital. They talk to Davidi, who regrets that he was not with her. She is not angry, but states that he will always be the baby's father, even if he is not ready or does not like it. Miraculously, police were at school when Tom died. Someone entered the Hanoch's office and he is convinced that he is David for revengeing him. The investigator tells him that he knows he has hidden that Ido has committed suicide. Hanoch justifies that another family is involved. / Към разследването се прибавя още една смърт. Но дали е самоубийство или инцидент, не знаят. Допускат свръхдоза, заради която момчето се е удавило. Но той е бил плувец. В кръвта му е имало антидепресанти и лекарство срещу халюцинации. Семейството отказва аутопсия. Натали и Гай смятат, че Том се е измъкнал, защото от тримата, които са били в коридора единият е мъртъв, тя е завинаги в количка, остава само той. Неговата майка е отчаяна и съжалява, че е била сляпа за депресията му, тревогата и самотата. Мири постъпва в болница. Разговарят с Давиди, който съжалява, че не е бил с нея. Тя не се сърди, но заявява, че той винаги ще бъде баща на бебето, дори да не е готов или да не му харесва. По чудо полицията е била в училището, когато Том е умрял. Някой е влизал в кабинета на Ханох и той е убеден, че е Давиди, че му отмъщава. Следователят му казва, че знае, че е скрил, че Идо се е самоубил. Ханох се оправдава, че е замесено и друго семейство.

programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Black space / Черно пространство
programme.desc: Davidi officially accuses Eran of killing 5 children and arrested him. He thinks he wanted to take revenge on Ido's death. The inspector tells him of the first three killed children, about entering the tunnel, about dressing up, about printed pistols, but there is one question. What happened there, down, and why Dor Oon killed. The interrogation lasts for a long time, but Eran denies everything. He states that he will not speak anymore without his father, the mayor. But Davidi realizes that they are planning something and Eran follows his watch. Immediately they have to find the video operator. In the rubber, the inspector realizes that this is the girl Libby. Police are looking for her immediately, finding that her parents have been in Kenya for two months. They follow Itar's phone, it turns out to be in the school. They are all there at a mask ball and they will kill Libby. Rousseau wants to take her out. The last action begins. Miri gives birth. / Давиди официално обвинява Еран в убийството на 5 деца и го арестува. Смята, че е искал да си отмъсти за смъртта на Идо. Инспекторът му разказва за първите три убити деца, за влизането в тунела, за преобличането, за принтираните пистолети, но има един въпрос. Какво се е случило там, долу, и защо е убил Дор Орон. Разпитът продължава дълго, но Еран отрича всичко. Заявява, че няма да говори повече без баща си, кмета. Но Давиди разбира, че планират нещо и Еран следи часовника си. Веднага гтрябва да открият оператора на видеото. По гуменките инспекторът разбира, че това е момичето Либи. Полицията веднага я търси, установява, че родителите й от два месеца са в Кения. Проследяват телефона на Итамар, оказва се че е в училището. Всички са там на маскен бал и ще убият Либи. Русо иска да я изведе. Започва последната акция. Мири ражда.

programme.title: Land / Проект "Земя"

Prkoseći smrti
programme.desc: When the famous Illusionist Harry Houdini (Guy Pearce) arrives in Edinburgh and offer a prize of £ 10,000 to who can establish contact with his dead mother, beautiful, but a deceptive woman presumably as a medium and her daughter take over a challenge. How Houdini spends time with a mysterious woman, he becomes seduced by her charms, and what he starts as an ordinary scam, starts to change into a far more complex and dangerous affair. / Kada poznati iluzionist Harry Houdini (Guy Pearce) doputuje u Edinburg i ponudi nagradu od 10.000 funti onome tko može da uspostavi kontakt sa njegovom mrtvom majkom, lijepa, ali varljiva žena koja se predstavlja kao medij i njena kćer preuzimaju izazov. Kako Houdini provodi vrijeme sa misterioznom ženom, on postaje zaveden njenim čarima, i ono što započne kao obična prevara, počinje se mijenjati u daleko složeniju i opasniju aferu.

programme.desc: DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cups dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Program, Germany) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cups dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

The second phase of qualification includes the best European representative teams and the winners of the group first phase. The first two places in each group in the second phase are made by placement to the final tournament. Other positions are divided among the best-placed third teams from the group ... / Handball - EHF European Championship Qualifiers - (sport. program) Nastup u kvalifikacijama za završni turnir najboljih momčadi starog kontinenta imaju sve europske reprezentacije osim domaćina i posljednjeg europskog prvaka. Tako da kvalifikacije nude brojne zanimljive i napete utakmice kroz dvije kvalifikacijske faze. U prvoj fazi se nalaze momčadi koje imaju niži ranking te su raspoređene u skupine po četiri ekipe gdje samo pobjednik prolazi u narednu fazu. Druga faza kvalifikacija uključuje najbolje europske reprezentativne timove te pobjednike skupina prve faze. Prva dva mjesta u svakoj grupi u drugoj fazi donose plasman na završni turnir. Ostale pozicije se dijele među najbolje plasiranim trećim ekipama iz skupina...

Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Soldier No. 1 - The General and the turn of the times / Soldat Nr. 1 - Der General und die Zeitenwende
programme.desc: The fact that Russia is preparing for a big conflict with NATO has been heard again and again for months. Carsten Breuer, General Inspector of the Bundeswehr, is the top soldier in Germany, probably the most impressive reminder: In a few years, he says, Russia is ready for a military conflict with the West. How does the Bundeswehr arise against this possible threat? What role does the general inspector play? The ARD journalist Willem Konrad and Lucas Stratmann has succeeded in accompanying Carsten Breuer with her camera for over nine months-for a conversation with Federal President Frank-Walter Steinmeier (SPD), while traveling to the Sudlibanon, Ukraine and the USA. The result is a portrait of the federal government's highest military advisor with deep insights into the German security apparatus. Carsten Breuer redefines the role of the general inspector of the interface between military and politics. Unlike his events, he is looking for the public to place his messages: in detailed newspaper interviews, in talk shows, in a conversation with burgers. Bundeswehr and society had to be warming, a term that comes from his pen and is often quoted, because of this? In Germany, Horbar will be long voices, which are concerned about an escalation with Russia and who have a skepticism in Germany. How does Breuer evaluate the criticism and the desire for more diplomatic means? The Bundeswehr rehearses the defense case in Lithuania in the NATO network. By 2027, a German brigade is to grow to a good 5000 soldiers - to deterrent against Russia. In mid -May, General Breuer will receive a military briefing over the current enemy and inspects the militaries from the hatch of the Guardian tank Puma. The exercise is suddenly interrupted, militar radio is parked. A Russian clearing aircraft was apparently seen in the airspace over the exercise. Intermediate trap like this has been in the past few months. Cyber ​​attacks, sabotage to military facilities, destroyed submarines and drone superfluge - all of this is Putin's tests to test defense and resilience, says Breuer. Because from the Russian perspective there is a long war with the West. The "Ard Story" accompanies a man who has so far had to prepare the Bundeswehr for possible seriousness almost unnoticed by the public. Who is the man who depends on so much and what role does he play for Germany? / Dass Russland sich auf einen groSSen Konflikt mit der NATO vorbereitet, ist seit Monaten immer wieder zu horen. Carsten Breuer, Generalinspekteur der Bundeswehr, ist als oberster Soldat Deutschlands der wohl eindrucklichste Mahner: Bereits in wenigen Jahren, so sagt er, sei Russland bereit fur einen militarischen Konflikt mit dem Westen. Wie stellt sich die Bundeswehr gegen diese mogliche Bedrohung auf? Welche Rolle spielt dabei der Generalinspekteur?Den ARD-Journalisten Willem Konrad und Lucas Stratmann ist es gelungen, Carsten Breuer uber neun Monate exklusiv mit ihrer Kamera zu begleiten - zum Gesprach mit Bundesprasident Frank-Walter Steinmeier (SPD), auf Reisen in den Sudlibanon, die Ukraine und die USA. Entstanden ist ein Portrat des obersten militarischen Beraters der Bundesregierung mit tiefen Einblicken in den deutschen Sicherheitsapparat.An der Schnittstelle zwischen Militar und Politik definiert Carsten Breuer die Rolle des Generalinspekteurs neu. Anders als seine Vorganger sucht er die Öffentlichkeit, um seine Botschaften zu platzieren: in ausfuhrlichen Zeitungsinterviews, in Talkshows, im Gesprach mit Burgern. Bundeswehr und Gesellschaft mussten kriegstuchtig werden, ein Begriff, der mit aus seiner Feder stammt und oft zitiert wird.Doch gehen da alle mit? In Deutschland werden langst Stimmen horbar, die sich vor einer Eskalation mit Russland sorgen und die Aufrustung in Deutschland mit Skepsis beaugen. Wie bewertet Breuer die Kritik und den Wunsch nach mehr diplomatischen Mitteln?Wahrenddessen probt die Bundeswehr im NATO-Verbund den Verteidigungsfall in Litauen. Bis 2027 soll dort eine deutsche Brigade auf gut 5000 Soldatinnen und Soldaten anwachsen - zur Abschreckung gegen Russland.Im Brigade-Quartier in Vilnius bekommt General Breuer dort Mitte Mai ein militarisches Briefing uber die aktuelle Feindlage und inspiziert die Militarubung aus der Luke des Schutzenpanzers Puma heraus. Plotzlich wird die Übung unterbrochen, der Militarfunk abgestellt. Ein russisches Aufklarungsflugzeug wurde offenbar im Luftraum uber der Übung gesichtet. Zwischenfalle wie dieser haufen sich in den letzten Monaten. Cyberangriffe, Sabotage an Militareinrichtungen, zerstorte Unterseekabel und Drohnenuberfluge - das alles seien Putins Tests, um Verteidigungsfahigkeit und Resilienz zu testen, so Breuer. Denn aus russischer Sicht herrsche langst Krieg mit dem Westen.Die "ARD Story" begleitet einen Mann, der bislang fast unbemerkt von der Öffentlichkeit eher im Hintergrund die Bundeswehr fur mogliche Ernstfalle vorbereiten muss. Wer ist der Mann, von dem so viel abhangt, und welche Rolle spielt er fur Deutschland?

programme.title: Echtes Leben
programme.sub-title: Until death divided us / Bis der Tod uns schied
programme.desc: The film has the story of Claudia Finke. Your life will be turned upside down in September 2023. Husband Uwe Korous get the diagnosis as. The incurable nervous disease is progressing quickly. For Claudia this is a great emotional challenge. Despite the rapid deterioration of his condition, Uwe decides to actively shape his remaining time. He still wants to realize dreams, for example with the paraglider over the Tyrolean mountains. Claudia is always by his side and supports him, with everything he was up to. When Uwe Spurt that his life at home is no longer worth living, he goes to the hospice. There he says goodbye, and Claudia is with him, until the end. The film shows how both deal with the incurable disease, such as Claudia Uwes decision to determine his end himself, how she can cope with the loss and live on after his death. / Der Film erzahlt die Geschichte von Claudia Finke. Ihr Leben wird im September 2023 auf den Kopf gestellt. Ehemann Uwe Korous erhalt die Diagnose ALS. Die unheilbare Nervenkrankheit schreitet bei ihm schnell voran. Fur Claudia ist das eine groSSe emotionale Herausforderung. Trotz der rasanten Verschlechterung seines Zustands, entscheidet Uwe, seine verbleibende Zeit aktiv zu gestalten. Er will noch Traume verwirklichen, etwa mit dem Gleitschirm uber die Tiroler Berge fliegen. Claudia ist immer an seiner Seite und unterstutzt ihn, bei allem, was er vorhat. Als Uwe spurt, dass sein Leben zu Hause nicht mehr lebenswert ist, geht er ins Hospiz. Dort nimmt er Abschied, und Claudia ist bei ihm, bis zuletzt.Der Film zeigt, wie beide mit der unheilbaren Krankheit umgehen, wie Claudia Uwes Entscheidung, uber sein Ende selbst zu bestimmen, mittragt, wie sie mit dem Verlust klarkommt und nach seinem Tod weiterlebt.

Carsten Breuer, Generalinspekteur der Bundeswehr, ist als oberster Soldat Deutschlands der wohl eindrucklichste Mahner: Bereits in wenigen Jahren, so sagt er, sei Russland bereit fur einen militarischen Konflikt mit dem Westen. Wie stellt sich die Bundeswehr gegen diese mogliche Bedrohung auf? Welche Rolle spielt dabei der Generalinspekteur?Den ARD-Journalisten Willem Konrad und Lucas Stratmann ist es gelungen, Carsten Breuer uber neun Monate exklusiv mit ihrer Kamera zu begleiten - zum Gesprach mit Bundesprasident Frank-Walter Steinmeier (SPD), auf Reisen in den Sudlibanon, die Ukraine und die USA. Entstanden ist ein Portrat des obersten militarischen Beraters der Bundesregierung mit tiefen Einblicken in den deutschen Sicherheitsapparat.An der Schnittstelle zwischen Militar und Politik definiert Carsten Breuer die Rolle des Generalinspekteurs neu. Anders als seine Vorganger sucht er die Öffentlichkeit, um seine Botschaften zu platzieren: in ausfuhrlichen Zeitungsinterviews, in Talkshows, im Gesprach mit Burgern. Bundeswehr und Gesellschaft mussten kriegstuchtig werden, ein Begriff, der mit aus seiner Feder stammt und oft zitiert wird.Doch gehen da alle mit? In Deutschland werden langst Stimmen horbar, die sich vor einer Eskalation mit Russland sorgen und die Aufrustung in Deutschland mit Skepsis beaugen. Wie bewertet Breuer die Kritik und den Wunsch nach mehr diplomatischen Mitteln?Wahrenddessen probt die Bundeswehr im NATO-Verbund den Verteidigungsfall in Litauen. Bis 2027 soll dort eine deutsche Brigade auf gut 5000 Soldatinnen und Soldaten anwachsen - zur Abschreckung gegen Russland.Im Brigade-Quartier in Vilnius bekommt General Breuer dort Mitte Mai ein militarisches Briefing uber die aktuelle Feindlage und inspiziert die Militarubung aus der Luke des Schutzenpanzers Puma heraus. Plotzlich wird die Übung unterbrochen, der Militarfunk abgestellt. Ein russisches Aufklarungsflugzeug wurde offenbar im Luftraum uber der Übung gesichtet. Zwischenfalle wie dieser haufen sich in den letzten Monaten. Cyberangriffe, Sabotage an Militareinrichtungen, zerstorte Unterseekabel und Drohnenuberfluge - das alles seien Putins Tests, um Verteidigungsfahigkeit und Resilienz zu testen, so Breuer. Denn aus russischer Sicht herrsche langst Krieg mit dem Westen.Die "ARD Story" begleitet einen Mann, der bislang fast unbemerkt von der Öffentlichkeit eher im Hintergrund die Bundeswehr fur mogliche Ernstfalle vorbereiten muss. Wer ist der Mann, von dem so viel abhangt, und welche Rolle spielt er fur Deutschland?

programme.sub-title: The taste of chrome and leather / Der Geschmack von Chrom und Leder
programme.desc: Actually, Hubert and Girwidz only want to bring his football back to little Fabian, who ended up in a foreign garage. There you will not only find the ball, but also the body of real estate agents Thorsten Falk. On the other hand, Falk's expensive motorcycle has disappeared, with which he likes to go out into nature with like -minded people - also on the day of his murder. In addition to his widow, Falk's biker colleagues are also suspected. The police therefore want to put someone in the motorcycle group. The problem with this: Nobody in the area can drive motorcycle. / Eigentlich wollen Hubert und Girwidz nur dem kleinen Fabian seinen FuSSball zuruckbringen, der in einer fremden Garage gelandet ist. Dort aber finden sie nicht nur den Ball, sondern auch die Leiche von Immobilienmakler Thorsten Falk. Neben seiner Witwe geraten auch Falks Biker-Kollegen in Verdacht. Die Polizei will deshalb jemanden in die Motorradgruppe einschleusen. Das Problem dabei: Niemand im Revier kann Motorrad fahren.

programme.title: Knowledge before eight earth / Wissen vor acht - Erde
programme.sub-title: How sustainable is wood? / Wie nachhaltig ist Holz?
programme.desc: Wood is enjoying increasing popularity as a renewable and sustainable raw material. The EU calls for the use of wood, which is burned in large quantities as a renewable energy source. Other industries also rely on wood, but this increases our global wood requirements and the forest dangerously. So how can wood be a sustainable raw material? More on this with "Knowledge before eight - earth". / Holz erfreut sich als nachwachsender und nachhaltiger Rohstoff zunehmender Beliebtheit. Die EU fordert die Nutzung von Holz, das in groSSen Mengen als erneuerbare Energiequelle verbrannt wird. Auch andere Industrien setzen verstarkt auf Holz, was jedoch unseren globalen Holzbedarf erhoht und die Walder gefahrdet. Wie kann Holz also ein nachhaltiger Rohstoff sein? Mehr dazu bei "Wissen vor acht - Erde".

programme.title: Shut Up, Bitch!
programme.desc: Wie gerat ein junger Mensch in den Bann frauenfeindlicher Online-Ideologien? Die ARD-Dokumentation taucht tief ein in ein Netzwerk aus YouTubern, Influencern und TikTok-Kanalen, die mit aggressiver Mannlichkeitsrhetorik Millionen junger Manner erreichen. Der Film begleitet zwei junge Menschen, deren Leben und politische Einstellungen sich durch die Inhalte dieser Parallelwelt entscheidend verandert haben, und macht deutlich, mit welcher Dynamik diese Netzwerke agieren. Hinter deren Erfolg stehen nicht nur Algorithmen, die diese Inhalte nach vorne spulen, sondern auch wirtschaftliche Interessen und eine politische Strategie. Die Dokumentation zeigt, wie frauenfeindliche Narrative gezielt fur Wahlkampfe genutzt werden - und weshalb sie eine wachsende Gefahr fur die Gleichberechtigung und die Demokratie darstellen.

programme.title: Echtes Leben
programme.sub-title: FuSSballprofi Benjamin Henrichs - Vom Verletzungsschock zum Comeback-Traum
programme.desc: Millions see this football evening shortly before Christmas 2024, as he collapses. Benjamin Henrichs, RB Leipzig-Profi and German international, lies on the lawn and cries. His Achilles tendon is torn. Just like that. After a bang as loud as a lash. Without an opponent having to go. At the end of the top game against Bavaria Munchen, which RB Leipzig loses high, Sanitter has to carry the 28-year-old floodlights. A light that Benjamin Henrich has known since the beginning of his steep career. Thousands of fans and followers praise Henrich's player to heaven when he conjures up the ball, or have it when a game goes wrong. This light is sophisticated, Benjamin Henrichs simply a person who suffers and has doubts. Can I play again at some point? Who am I without football? Who is really to me? A tear of the Achilles tendon is considered one of the worst injuries that an athlete can have. The healing process is complicated. Output uncertain. Benjamin Henrichs tries to at least gain control over part of his life. He begins to document his injury and the healing process in film. With the help of his sister Tabea, who has often stood in her brother's shadow, a very personal insight is created. "Faith Over Fear" calls you the documentary that is intended for his followers. In German: Faith overflows fear. It deals with his injury, his belief in God and his struggle, to be able to play again. Maybe in the new season. At the latest for the 2026 World Cup, he wants to stand on the pitch again. The last word of whether his comeback dream will go into fulfillment, neither he nor any coach, Benjamin Henrichs is certain. Questions about your own life, the meaning of the whole and about what really pays: people who are close to us who only see us. No matter what status we have. / Millionen sehen an diesem FuSSballabend kurz vor Weihnachten 2024, wie er zusammenbricht. Benjamin Henrichs, RB-Leipzig-Profi und deutscher Nationalspieler, liegt auf dem Rasen und weint. Seine Achillessehne ist gerissen. Einfach so. Nach einem Knall so laut wie ein Peitschenhieb. Ohne dass ihn ein Gegner beruhrt hat. Am Ende des Spitzenspiels gegen Bayern Munchen, das RB Leipzig haushoch verliert, mussen Sanitater den 28-Jahrigen aus dem gleiSSenden Flutlicht tragen.Ein Licht, das Benjamin Henrichs seit Beginn seiner steilen Karriere kennt. Tausende Fans und Follower loben den Spieler Henrichs in den Himmel, wenn er mit dem Ball zaubert, oder haten ihn, wenn ein Spiel danebengeht. Plotzlich ist dieses Licht aus, Benjamin Henrichs einfach ein Mensch, der leidet und Zweifel hat. Kann ich irgendwann wieder spielen? Wer bin ich ohne FuSSball? Wer halt wirklich zu mir?Ein Riss der Achillessehne gilt als eine der schlimmsten Verletzungen, die ein Sportler haben kann. Der Heilungsprozess ist kompliziert. Ausgang ungewiss. Benjamin Henrichs versucht, zumindest uber einen Teil seines Lebens die Kontrolle zu gewinnen. Er beginnt, sich, seine Verletzung und den Heilungsprozess filmisch zu dokumentieren. Mit Hilfe seiner Schwester Tabea, die oft im Schatten ihres Bruders gestanden hat, entsteht ein sehr personlicher Einblick."Faith over Fear" nennen sie die Dokumentation, die fur seine Follower bestimmt ist. Zu Deutsch: Glaube uberwindet Angst. Darin geht es um seine Verletzung, seinen Glauben an Gott und seinen Kampf, wieder spielen zu konnen. Vielleicht in der neuen Saison. Spatestens zur WM 2026 will er wieder auf dem Platz stehen. Das letzte Wort daruber, ob sein Comeback-Traum in Erfullung gehen wird, haben weder er noch irgendein Trainer, ist sich Benjamin Henrichs sicher.In der "Echtes-Leben"-Reportage spricht der glaubige Christ offen uber seinen Glauben und stellt sich inmitten seiner Krise groSSen Fragen, die uns alle angehen. Fragen nach dem eigenen Lebensweg, dem Sinn des Ganzen und nach dem, was wirklich zahlt: Menschen, die uns nahestehen, die nur uns sehen. Egal, welchen Status wir haben.

programme.title: For always in the heart / Fur immer im Herzen
programme.desc: The attractive publishing manager Julia Berger (Natalia Worner) apparently has everything you can wish for: a responsible profession, a likeable friend, a chic apartment and a racy sports car. However, what she doesn't have is a private life. This gets both her long-term friend Fred (Horst-Gunter Marx) traces and her family, whom she has hardly any contact. The relationship with her father Richard (Hanns Zischler) is very distant, and her younger sister Isabell (Julia Jager) suffers from never having a professional success like Julia. Only for her ten -year -old nephew Stefan (Patrick Baehr) Julia has a very close relationship. It is all the more shocked when one day it turns out that Stefan has a severe form of bone cancer. The boy is admitted to a children's clinic where the treating doctor Dr. Boppard (Hannes Jaenicke) takes on both the children and the members with a lot of empathy overmoth. However, it doesn't take long for the mentally unstable Isabell to no longer grow to emotional pressure. After a nervous break, she is looking for help in a clinic. However, her professional career suffers from this. Julia will soon be presented to the publisher before choosing: does she continue to take out her fuid position or increasingly devote herself to her private environment? For the first time, self -confident Julia threatens to lose control over her life. When she gets little later with her sister, at the same time saves an important merger wife of her publisher, and little Stefan is released from the hospital with good forecasts, everything seems to be turning. But just when Julia full of self -confidence discusses her further career with her CEO, the news arrives that Stefan's condition has suddenly deteriorated. / Die attraktive Verlagsleiterin Julia Berger (Natalia Worner) hat scheinbar alles, was man sich nur wunschen kann: einen verantwortungsvollen Beruf, einen sympathischen Freund, eine schicke Wohnung und einen rassigen Sportwagen. Was sie jedoch nicht hat, ist ein Privatleben. Das bekommt sowohl ihr Dauerfreund Fred (Horst-Gunter Marx) zu spuren als auch ihre Familie, zu der sie kaum noch Kontakt hat. Das Verhaltnis zu ihrem Vater Richard (Hanns Zischler) ist sehr distanziert, und ihre jungere Schwester Isabell (Julia Jager) leidet darunter, nie einen beruflichen Erfolg wie Julia erlangt zu haben. Einzig zu ihrem zehnjahrigen Neffen Stefan (Patrick Baehr) hat Julia ein sehr enges Verhaltnis. Umso schockierter ist sie, als sich eines Tages herausstellt, dass Stefan an einer schweren Form von Knochenkrebs erkrankt ist. Der Junge wird in eine Kinderklinik eingewiesen, wo sich der behandelnde Arzt Dr. Boppard (Hannes Jaenicke) mit viel Einfuhlungsvermogen sowohl der Kinder als auch der Angehorigen annimmt. Es dauert jedoch nicht lange, bis die psychisch labile Isabell dem emotionalen Druck nicht mehr gewachsen ist. Nach einem Nervenzusammenbruch sucht sie auf Julias Drangen Hilfe in einer Klinik.Nun steht Julia vor der schweren Aufgabe, dem kranken, von der Chemotherapie gezeichneten Stefan ganz alleine beizustehen. Darunter leidet jedoch ihre berufliche Karriere. Schon bald wird Julia im Verlag vor die Wahl gestellt: Will sie weiterhin ihre Fuhrungsposition ausuben oder sich zunehmend ihrem privaten Umfeld widmen? Zum ersten Mal droht die selbstbewusste Julia die Kontrolle uber ihr Leben zu verlieren. Als sie wenig spater mit ihrer Schwester ins Reine kommt, zugleich ein wichtiges Fusionsgeschaft ihres Verlages rettet, und der kleine Stefan mit guten Prognosen aus dem Krankenhaus entlassen wird, scheint sich endlich alles zum Guten zu wenden. Aber gerade als Julia voller Selbstsicherheit mit ihren Vorstandschefs uber ihre weitere Karriere diskutiert, trifft die Nachricht ein, dass Stefans Zustand sich schlagartig verschlechtert hat.

programme.title: Hubert und Staller
programme.desc: The private cleaning lady of district manager Girwidz Kerstin Wilm is intended to bring the police station to the fore for a press appointment. But just when she wants to update Huberts and Staller's Saustall, she succumbs a poisoning - through tea bags! The first trace takes the two police officers into a luxurious fruhstuck scafe. According to a reservation bureau, the dead cleaning lady had made an appointment there with a stranger. Surprisingly, the stranger turns out to be district manager Girwidz. In return, the cleaning lady had asked him for the cleaning campaign for a favor. Girwidz cannot say what it was about. The case is clear for Staller: here was jealousy in the game. Hubert has a different guess: Kerstin Wilm had private information about her customers about whom she always liked to gossip. She hadn't stopped even in front of Girwidz. So what if she had found something about one of her customers that she better not found out? For example, the lawyer's wife Lotte Sommer, who with her boyish gartner, not only stopped the hedges; Or her husband, notary Andreas Sommer, who is said to have received the chic house by the lake by inheritance. In addition, there were the iglhauts who had driven down the manor of their deceased large -stented and were disinherited in a common way; Or that uncanny puppet doctor who still lives with mom and restored broken porcelain dolls. Suddenly more questions arise: what about the ominos letter that cleaner Kerstin inherited from the late large -stente iglhaut? And why is Girwidz actively involved in the investigation? But even though Hubert excludes a relationship between Girwidz and Kerstin Wilm, it is a girwidz connection to his cleaning lady who leads to the solution of the case. / Die private Putzfrau von Revierleiter Girwidz Kerstin Wilm soll das Polizeirevier fur einen Pressetermin auf Vordermann bringen. Doch gerade, als sie Huberts und Stallers Saustall aufraumen will, erliegt sie einer Vergiftung - durch Teebeutel! Die erste Spur fuhrt die beiden Polizisten in ein luxurioses Fruhstuckscafe. Laut einer Reservierungsbestatigung hatte sich die tote Putzfrau dort mit einem Unbekannten zum Fruhstuck verabredet. Überraschenderweise entpuppt sich der Unbekannte als Revierleiter Girwidz. Die Putzfrau hatte ihn im Gegenzug fur die Putzaktion um einen Gefallen gebeten. Worum es dabei ging, kann Girwidz nicht sagen. Fur Staller ist der Fall klar: Hier war Eifersucht im Spiel. programme.title: Tiroler Bauernhauser - Zwischen Romantik und Realitat
programme.desc: "As soon as the flies revolve around the soup, the romanticism at the farm catches up," says Tyrolean farmer and actor Tobias Moretti. With his wife Julia, he manages an old farm near Innsbruck. "We voluntarily bought hard work," says the passionate farmer Julia Moretti. 30 years ago, 700 powdery ensembles were preserved in Tyrol, today there are just 80. For this riveting result there is a study carried out by the Tyrolean art cadastre. Julia Moretti is committed to the "Langenfeld explanation" as an ambassador for the "Landliche Baukultur. But what does an active farmer do with an old farm who is a listed building and who is difficult to manage with a modern tractor? Teresa Andreae, the designer of the documentary, visited several historical farmers' farm in North and East Tyrol with her team and shows in Austria, picture "Tiroler Bauernhauser - between romanticism and reality" which different forms of continued life are possible. / "Sobald die Fliegen aus dem Stall um die Suppe kreisen, hort sich die Romantik am Bauernhof auf", sagt der Tiroler Bauer und Schauspieler Tobias Moretti. Er bewirtschaftet mit seiner Frau Julia einen alten Hof in der Nahe von Innsbruck. "Wir haben uns freiwillig harte Arbeit gekauft", sagt die leidenschaftliche Bauerin Julia Moretti. Vor 30 Jahren waren in Tirol noch 700 bauerliche Ensembles erhalten, heute sind es gerade noch 80. Zu diesem aufruttelnden Ergebnis kommt eine vom Tiroler Kunstkataster durchgefuhrte Studie. Julia Moretti engagiert sich als Botschafterin fur die "Langenfelder Erklarung", das ist ein Pladoyer fur den Erhalt von landlicher Baukultur. Doch was tut ein aktiver Bauer mit einem alten Hof, der unter Denkmalschutz steht, und der sich mit einem modernen Traktor nur schwer bewirtschaften lasst? Teresa Andreae, die Gestalterin der Dokumentation, hat mit ihrem Team mehrere historische Bauernhofe in Nord- und Osttirol besucht und zeigt im Österreich Bild am Feiertag "Tiroler Bauernhauser - Zwischen Romantik und Realitat" welche unterschiedlichen Formen des Weiterlebens moglich sind.

programme.title: kreuz und quer
programme.sub-title: To the most extreme - bishop Erwin Krautler / Bis zum ÄuSSersten - Bischof Erwin Krautler
programme.desc: He was seriously injured in a murder attack - and years later awarded the alternative Nobel Prize: Erwin Krautler, Birthtiger Vorarlberger, was from 1981 to 2015 Catholic Bishop of Xingu, the flat -massive diozese of Brazil. Peter Beringer's film traces the most important life stations of Krautler: A portrait that shows how the Christian faith of the Austro-Brazilian bishop manifests itself in his acting force for the indigenous population of Amazonia and for the preservation of the rainforest. / Er wurde bei einem Mordanschlag schwer verletzt - und Jahre spater mit dem alternativen Nobelpreis ausgezeichnet: Erwin Krautler, geburtiger Vorarlberger, war von 1981 bis 2015 katholischer Bischof von Xingu, der flachenmaSSig groSSten Diozese Brasiliens. Der Film von Peter Beringer zeichnet die wichtigsten Lebensstationen Krautlers nach: ein Portrat, das zeigt, wie sich der christliche Glaube des austro-brasilianischen Bischofs in seinem tatkraftigen Engagement fur die indigene Bevolkerung Amazoniens und fur die Erhaltung des Regenwaldes manifestiert.

programme.title: Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: 1,100 years of Holy Wolfgang - people and legends at the Wolfgangsee / 1.100 Jahre Heiliger Wolfgang - Menschen und Legenden am Wolfgangsee
programme.desc: For over 1000 years, people from all over the world have had a pilgrimage to the Wolfgangsee to follow the traces of St. Wolfgang and drink on his healing source or to drop "miracle water". They admire his church in St. Wolfgang with the based Michael Pacher -Altar - he shows the wolf legend - and ask for buses and healing. The pilgrimage passed the culture and economy of the region around the Abersee, as the Wolfgangsee originated originally. Gastricifications, breweries, gingerbread manufacturers, drives and glass huts already developed at the time, because the pilgrims wanted to be cared for, just like the numerous tourists from today. / Seit uber 1000 Jahren pilgern Menschen aus aller Welt an den Wolfgangsee, um den Spuren des Heiligen Wolfgang zu folgen und an seiner Heilquelle zu trinken oder "Wunderwasser" abzufullen. Sie bewundern seine Kirche in St. Wolfgang mit dem beruhmten Michael Pacher-Altar - er zeigt die Wolfganglegende - und bitten um BuSSe und Heilung.Die Pilgerfahrt pragte die Kultur und Wirtschaft der Region rund um den Abersee, wie der Wolfgangsee ursprunglich geheiSSen hat. Gastwirtschaften, Brauereien, Lebkuchenherstellern, Fahrbetrieben und Glashutten entwickelten sich bereits damals, denn die Pilgerreisenden wollten versorgt sein, genauso wie die zahlreichen Touristinnen und Touristen von heute.Peter Beringer begibt sich auf eine spannende Spurensuche nach dem Heiligen Wolfgang und seiner Wirkung auf die Menschen und die Landschaft.

programme.title: Der Geschmack Europas
programme.desc: This time Lojze Wieser and Florian Gebauer are looking for the taste of Europe on the British Islands, more precisely after Wales. In the country of myths and legends, the Welsh language is still widespread and flags with the legendary red kite crowns are the historical fortresses and castles, of which there are more than 600 in number than in any other country in Europe. These are not only the remains of history but also proof of Wales Wild past. On the trip, Lojze Wieser costs itself through the typical-Welsh taste of Laverbread, Heart Mussels, Bara Brith or the typical Fish and Chips and meets people who can transfer the old recipes to today. / Diesmal verschlagt es Lojze Wieser und Florian Gebauer auf der Suche nach dem Geschmack Europas auf die Britischen Inseln, genauer gesagt nach Wales.Im Land der Mythen und Legenden ist die walisische Sprache noch weit verbreitet und Flaggen mit dem legendaren roten Drachen kronen die historischen Festungen und Burgen, von denen es in Wales mehr als 600 an der Zahl gibt und damit mehr als in jedem anderen Land Europas. Diese sind nicht nur Überreste der Geschichte sondern auch ein Beweis fur Wales wilde Vergangenheit.Auf der Reise kostet sich Lojze Wieser durch die typisch-walisischen Geschmacker von Laverbread, Herzmuscheln, Bara Brith oder den typischen Fish and Chips und trifft auf Menschen, die die alten Rezepte ins Heute ubertragen konnen.

programme.title: Netanjahu - Die Anklage des Internationalen Strafgerichtshofs
programme.desc: Seit November 2024 ist ein Haftbefehl des Internationalen Strafgerichtshofs IStGH gegen Israels Premierminister Netanjahu und seinen damaligen Verteidigungsminister Yoav Galant ausgeschrieben. Der IStGH wirft ihnen vor, fur Kriegsverbrechen und Verbrechen gegen die Menschlichkeit wahrend des Krieges in Gaza verantwortlich zu sein. Der Haftbefehl gegen Netanjahu ist der erste wegen Kriegsverbrechen gegen den Staatschef eines vom Westen unterstutzten demokratischen Landes.Das WELTjournal zeigt, worauf sich die Anschuldigungen des IStGH gegen Netanjahu und Galant stutzen. Die Zerstorung ganzer Wohnviertel mit zahllosen zivilen Todesopfern, die Zerstorung von landwirtschaftlichen Flachen und Teilen der Wasserversorgung, die Behinderung humanitarer Hilfe sowie Angriffe auf die medizinische Infrastruktur werden u.a. durch die Analyse von Satellitenbildern akribisch nachgewiesen. Zu Wort kommen israelische Politiker und Geheimdienst-Mitarbeiter ebenso wie Soldaten, Menschenrechtsorganisationen und die Familien der Geiseln.Gestaltung: Laetitia Moreau, Mitarbeit Matan Cohen

programme.title: Israels rechtsextreme Minister
programme.desc: Die beiden rechtsextremen Minister Bezalel Smotrich und Itamar Ben-Gvir reprasentieren nur einen kleinen Teil der israelischen Gesellschaft, doch in der Regierung Netanjahu haben sie uberproportional viel Macht und tragen maSSgeblich zur Radikalisierung der Politik bei. Ein Ende des Krieges in Gaza lehnen sie ab und fordern stattdessen eine Umsiedlung der Palastinenser und eine Besitznahme und israelische Besiedelung des palastinensischen Gazastreifens. Mehrere Lander wie Kanada, Australien, GroSSbritannien, Norwegen und das EU-Land Slowenien haben Sanktionen gegen sie verhangt.Das WELTjournal+ zeigt ein Portrat der beiden Minister, die eine gemeinsame ideologische Agenda verfolgen: die Annexion der besetzten palastinensischen Gebiete und ein GroSS-Israel. Gezeigt wird zugleich auch der Widerstand jener Israelis, die seit den Justiz-Umbauplanen der Netanjahu-Regierung das Ende der Demokratie in ihrem Staat befurchten. Zu Wort kommen die ehemaligen israelischen Ministerprasidenten Ehud Barak und Ehud Olmert und die fruhere Justizministerin Tzipi Livni, die - wie viele Israelis - mit Sorge auf die nationalreligiosen und rechtsextremen Stromungen in der Politik blicken.Gestaltung: Jerôme Sesquin

programme.title: Der Lissabon-Krimi
programme.desc: The flawless view of Padre Lima (Timur Isik) is a restless suspicion. Attorney Eduardo Silva (Jurgen Tarrach) takes over the defense of the clergy at the request of Marcias Uncle. But the confession secret is protecting the real culprit for the time being. Padre Lima's church is an important refuge for Lisbon's street children. There you get something to eat and accommodate. But many people in the district are the charitable activity of the Padre in the side of a thorn. When a street child is murdered, the suspicion of Lima falls. Fixed his innocence, lawyer Eduardo Silva takes over the defense of the priest. Shortly afterwards, however, a boy contacts the police and raises severe advance against Eduardo's clients. / Ein unruhmlicher Verdacht beschadigt das makellose Ansehen von Padre Lima (Timur Isik). Rechtsanwalt Eduardo Silva (Jurgen Tarrach) ubernimmt auf Wunsch von Marcias Onkel die Verteidigung des Geistlichen. Doch das Beichtgeheimnis schutzt vorerst den wahren Schuldigen.Padre Limas Kirche ist fur Lissabons StraSSenkinder ein wichtiger Zufluchtsort. Dort erhalten sie etwas zu essen und Unterkunft. Doch vielen Geschaftsleuten im Viertel ist die karitative Tatigkeit des Padres ein Dorn im Auge. Als ein StraSSenkind ermordet wird, fallt der Verdacht auf Lima. Fest von dessen Unschuld uberzeugt, ubernimmt Rechtsanwalt Eduardo Silva die Verteidigung des Priesters. Kurz darauf kontaktiert jedoch ein Bub die Polizei und erhebt schwere Vorwurfe gegen Eduardos Klienten.

programme.title: Schlosshotel Orth
programme.desc: Wenzel and Eva spend a weekend with Georg and Andrea. Wenzel is no longer sure of his feelings of Eva. Then Wenzel has a call from Suanne Neumann: Vinzenz secretly concluded a contract with the cheap provider "Easy Travel". Wenzel immediately drives to the hotel and leaves a cranked Eva back. He asked Vinzenz to make the contract in a jerkgang and celebrate it with Susanne. But a harmless dinner will soon become more. Robert and Erika Maendel are guests at the hotel to celebrate Robert's mother's birthday. The hopelessly disputed couple plays Ms. Maendel the big gluck because Robert promises a bigger inheritance. But the old woman Maendel is not from yesterday ... / Wenzel und Eva verbringen ein Wochenende bei Georg und Andrea. Wenzel ist sich seiner Gefuhle zu Eva nicht mehr sicher. Da ereilt Wenzel ein Anruf von Suanne Neumann: Vinzenz hat heimlich einen Vertrag mit dem Billig-Anbieter "Easy Travel" abgeschlossen. Wenzel fahrt sofort ins Hotel und lasst eine gekrankte Eva zuruck. Er notigt Vinzenz den Vertrag ruckgangig zu machen und feiert das mit Susanne. Aber aus einem harmlosen Dinner wird bald mehr. Zu Gast im Hotel sind Robert und Erika Maendel, um den Geburtstag von Roberts Mutter zu feiern. Das hoffnungslos zerstrittene Paar spielt Frau Maendel das groSSe Gluck vor, weil Robert sich davon eine groSSere Erbschaft verspricht. Aber die alte Frau Maendel ist nicht von gestern....

programme.title: Natur im Garten
programme.desc: "Nature in the Garden" celebrates an anniversary - the 400th program! Karl Ploberger and Krauterhexe Uschi Zezelitsch meet for a summer garden party and pretend the barnest garden stories from the past. Also included are the gardeners of the Garten Tulln Susanne Leeb, Tanja Hrovat and Christine Gall. As a total of more than 80 million viewers have been watching the garden magazine, which is for okological gardeners, since the 2006 broadcast. Across all federal countries, "Nature im Garden" Week for week visits interesting people who shape and maintain their green green with great love and passion. / "Natur im Garten" feiert ein Jubilaum - die bereits 400. Sendung!Karl Ploberger und Krauterhexe Uschi Zezelitsch treffen sich zu diesem Anlass zu einer sommerlichen Gartenparty und prasentieren die schonsten Gartengeschichten aus der Vergangenheit. Mit dabei sind auch die Gartnerinnen der Garten Tulln Susanne Leeb, Tanja Hrovat und Christine Gall.Insgesamt mehr als 80 Millionen Zuschauerinnen und Zuschauer verfolgten seit dem Sendestart 2006 das Gartenmagazin, das fur okologisches Gartnern steht. Quer durch alle Bundeslander besucht "Natur im Garten" Woche fur Woche interessante Menschen, die mit groSSer Liebe und Leidenschaft ihre grunen Paradiese gestalten und pflegen.

programme.title: Österreich-Bild aus dem Landesstudio Wien
programme.sub-title: Sport instead of violence - as Viennese clubs save young people from abyss / Sport statt Gewalt - Wie Wiener Vereine Jugendliche vor dem Abgrund retten
programme.desc: Reporting sport instead of violence shows how committed people in Viennese clubs try to keep children and young people on the right track with sports and prevent slipping into the criminal. Regardless of whether when boxing, football or basketball, who does sports and finds friends, may often get into stupid ideas out of boredom. The clubs go different ways. The focus is on rules, discipline and hard training in the Ottakringer Boxclub Bounce. The Kafigleague of Vienna Caritas is following a different approach. Anyone can come to the low -threshold football dates in the park. This is about reaching the children at all and building trust. Was also listen to the top of Basketballer Mohammad Yaseen and his club Basketball Plus. The plus stands for mental health and he wants to convey it about sport. The health coach, which himself has escape experience, catches up with a large number of young people - with sports and fun in basketball. A film by Barbara Lupac for the Vienna State Studio / Die Reportage Sport statt Gewalt zeigt, wie engagierte Menschen in Wiener Vereinen versuchen, Kinder und Jugendliche mit Sport auf dem richtigen Weg zu halten und ein Abrutschen ins Kriminal zu verhindern. Egal ob beim Boxen, beim Fussball oder beim Basketball, wer Sport macht und dabei Freunde findet, kommt vielleicht weniger oft aus Langeweile auf dumme Ideen.Dabei gehen die Vereine unterschiedliche Wege. Im Ottakringer Boxclub Bounce stehen Regeln, Disziplin und hartes Training im Vordergrund. Einen anderen Ansatz verfolgt die Kafigleague der Wiener Caritas. Zu den niederschwelligen Fussballterminen im Park kann jeder kommen. Hier geht es darum die Kinder uberhaupt einmal zu erreichen und Vertrauen aufzubauen. Zuhoren steht auch ganz oben bei Basketballer Mohammad Yaseen und seinem Verein Basketball Plus. Das Plus steht fur Mentale Gesundheit und die will er uber den Sport vermitteln. Der Gesundheits-Coach, der selbst Fluchterfahrung hat, fangt so eine groSSe Anzahl von Jugendlichen auf - mit Sport und SpaSS beim Basketball. Ein Film von Barbara Lupac fur das Landesstudio Wien

programme.title: Netanjahu - Die Anklage des Internationalen Strafgerichtshofs
programme.desc: Seit November 2024 ist ein Haftbefehl des Internationalen Strafgerichtshofs IStGH gegen Israels Premierminister Netanjahu und seinen damaligen Verteidigungsminister Yoav Galant ausgeschrieben. Der IStGH wirft ihnen vor, fur Kriegsverbrechen und Verbrechen gegen die Menschlichkeit wahrend des Krieges in Gaza verantwortlich zu sein. Der Haftbefehl gegen Netanjahu ist der erste wegen Kriegsverbrechen gegen den Staatschef eines vom Westen unterstutzten demokratischen Landes.Das WELTjournal zeigt, worauf sich die Anschuldigungen des IStGH gegen Netanjahu und Galant stutzen. Die Zerstorung ganzer Wohnviertel mit zahllosen zivilen Todesopfern, die Zerstorung von landwirtschaftlichen Flachen und Teilen der Wasserversorgung, die Behinderung humanitarer Hilfe sowie Angriffe auf die medizinische Infrastruktur werden u.a. durch die Analyse von Satellitenbildern akribisch nachgewiesen. Zu Wort kommen israelische Politiker und Geheimdienst-Mitarbeiter ebenso wie Soldaten, Menschenrechtsorganisationen und die Familien der Geiseln.Gestaltung: Laetitia Moreau, Mitarbeit Matan Cohen

programme.title: Israels rechtsextreme Minister
programme.desc: Die beiden rechtsextremen Minister Bezalel Smotrich und Itamar Ben-Gvir reprasentieren nur einen kleinen Teil der israelischen Gesellschaft, doch in der Regierung Netanjahu haben sie uberproportional viel Macht und tragen maSSgeblich zur Radikalisierung der Politik bei. Ein Ende des Krieges in Gaza lehnen sie ab und fordern stattdessen eine Umsiedlung der Palastinenser und eine Besitznahme und israelische Besiedelung des palastinensischen Gazastreifens. Mehrere Lander wie Kanada, Australien, GroSSbritannien, Norwegen und das EU-Land Slowenien haben Sanktionen gegen sie verhangt.Das WELTjournal+ zeigt ein Portrat der beiden Minister, die eine gemeinsame ideologische Agenda verfolgen: die Annexion der besetzten palastinensischen Gebiete und ein GroSS-Israel. Gezeigt wird zugleich auch der Widerstand jener Israelis, die seit den Justiz-Umbauplanen der Netanjahu-Regierung das Ende der Demokratie in ihrem Staat befurchten. Zu Wort kommen die ehemaligen israelischen Ministerprasidenten Ehud Barak und Ehud Olmert und die fruhere Justizministerin Tzipi Livni, die - wie viele Israelis - mit Sorge auf die nationalreligiosen und rechtsextremen Stromungen in der Politik blicken.Gestaltung: Jerôme Sesquin

programme.title: Barbara Kutlich - Talk at 4 / Barbara Karlich - Talk um 4
programme.sub-title: Money and Gluck: How much is enough? / Geld und Gluck: Wie viel ist genug?
programme.desc: A certain amount of financial security makes life easier: If you don't have to worry about the day -to -day, you can look more relaxed into the future. However, other factors are much more decisive than the account balance: time for family and friends, health, meaning in life and the possibility of realizing their own dreams. / Ein gewisses MaSS an finanzieller Sicherheit erleichtert das Leben: Wer sich keine Sorgen um das tagliche Auskommen machen muss, kann entspannter in die Zukunft blicken. Viel entscheidender als der Kontostand sind fur viele Menschen aber andere Faktoren: Zeit fur Familie und Freunde, Gesundheit, Sinn im Leben und die Moglichkeit, eigene Traume zu verwirklichen.
