programme.title: Land der Berge
programme.desc: While the cities grow and everyday life becomes denser, the longing of many people increases according to nature, silence and originality. The Alm is considered a romantic background - but behind the idyll there is often a hard everyday life. This new "Land of the Mountains" production embarks on an impressive journey into the Alpine World of the Salzburg country - to people who cultivate their alpine pastures with passion, perseverance and deeply rooted. On the Loseggalm and the Hoislalm you can find out from the challenges that tourism brings to the alpine pasture - where hiking trails drive through suckler cows and pretends to see new approaches to protect the willow animals. A special event is the Noriker stallion in Rauris. Here, cultural heritage becomes a social event and the Schachneralm shows how generational alpine pasture works - because it has been family -owned for over 200 years. The women are in the foreground when sheet bumbing on the Ellym in Unken. With their extensive knowledge of the healing effects of individual herbs, they contribute an important contribution to the preservation of old traditions and religious customs. / Wahrend Stadte wachsen und der Alltag dichter wird, steigt die Sehnsucht vieler Menschen nach Natur, Stille und Ursprunglichkeit. Die Alm gilt als romantischer Ruckzugsort - doch hinter der Idylle verbirgt sich oft ein harter Alltag.Diese neue "Land der Berge"-Produktion begibt sich auf eine eindrucksvolle Reise in die alpine Welt des Salzburger Landes - zu Menschen, die mit Leidenschaft, Ausdauer und tief verwurzelter Tradition ihre Almen bewirtschaften. Auf der Loseggalm und der Hoislalm erfahrt man von den Herausforderungen, die der Tourismus mit auf die Alm bringt - wo Wanderwege durch Mutterkuhherden fuhren und zuruckkehrende Raubtiere wie der Wolf neue Ansatze zum Schutz der Weidentiere fordern. Ein besonderes Ereignis ist der Noriker-Hengstauftrieb in Rauris. Hier wird kulturelles Erbe zum gesellschaftlichen Ereignis und die Schachneralm zeigt, wie generationenubergreifende Almwirtschaft funktioniert - denn sie ist bereits seit uber 200 Jahren in Familienbesitz. Beim Krauterbuschbinden auf der Ederalm in Unken stehen die Frauen im Vordergrund. Mit ihrem umfangreichen Wissen uber die heilende Wirkung einzelner Krauter tragen sie einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erhalt alter Traditionen und religiosem Brauchtum bei.

programme.title: Land der Berge
programme.desc: This "Land of Mountains" production goes on a cinematic foray from the Salzburg High Corigal massif to Grossarl Valley. The sharp spikes of these stone majesty are reminiscent of a crown and give an idea of ​​the unimaginable forces of nature that were at work when the powerful massif. The summit of the highly king, which belongs to the mountain range of the Berchtesgaden Alps, overrides all other mountains in the nearby area with its 2,941 meters and pays to the most prominent in the Alps. On the way down, from the rock cravings of the stone sea over the split alpine landscape, the habitat for flora and fauna becomes more friendly: roaring water traps and sadgrune alpine meadows hem. The landscape of the Grossarl Valley, which is also called the "valley of the Alms". There are about forty -managed alpine huts from early year to autumn. To date, the "Sauerkas" region for the region has been produced in a traditional way: skipped by hand, kneaded with a high effort and lifted in wooden shapes. In the main town of Grossarl, the spate baroque parish church is enthroned visibly over the old stone houses of the market. With traditional folk music, culinary peculiarities and real customs, a splendid Thanksgiving festival is celebrated here. Natural filmmaker Hans Jochler draws a picture of this angle of this angle of the Salzburg mountains that is as visual and lifelong in this "Land der Bergen". / Diese "Land der Berge"-Produktion begibt sich auf einen filmischen Streifzug vom Salzburger Hochkonigsmassiv ins malerische GroSSarltal. Die scharfen Zacken dieser steinernen Majestat erinnern an eine Krone und lassen die unvorstellbaren Krafte der Natur erahnen, die bei der Entstehung des machtigen Massivs am Werk waren. Der Gipfel des Hochkonig, der zum Gebirgsstock der Berchtesgadener Alpen gehort, uberragt mit seinen 2.941 Metern alle anderen Berge im naheren Umkreis und zahlt zu den prominentesten der Alpen. Am Weg hinab, von der Felswuste des Steinernen Meeres uber die zerkluftete alpine Landschaft, wird der Lebensraum fur Flora und Fauna allmahlich freundlicher: tosende Wasserfalle und sattgrune Almwiesen saumen das Landschaftsbild des GroSSarltals, das auch das "Tal der Almen" genannt wird. Von Fruhjahr bis Herbst gibt es etwa vierzig bewirtschaftete Almhutten. Bis heute wird hier der fur die Region typische "Sauerkas" nach traditioneller Art hergestellt: Von Hand abgeschopft, mit hohem Kraftaufwand geknetet und in holzerne Formen gehoben. Im Hauptort GroSSarl thront die spatbarocke Pfarrkirche weithin sichtbar uber den alten Steinhausern des Marktes. Mit traditioneller Volksmusik, kulinarischen Besonderheiten und echtem Brauchtum wird hier jahrlich die ein prachtiges Erntedank-Fest begangen. Naturfilmer Hans Jochler zeichnet in diesem "Land der Berge" ein ebenso bildgewaltiges wie lebensnahes Bild dieses Winkels der Salzburger Bergwelt.

programme.title: Sommerfrische in Karnten: Der Millstatter See
programme.desc: The location between the Nockberge biosphere park, the Hohe Tauern, the Goldeck and the Mirnock makes the Millstatter See region unique. It is a landscape full of myths and stories that harbors an ancient "treasure" with the grenade. At Karnten's deepest lake there is a mild, almost Mediterranean climate that attracted nobility and burger at the turn of the last century and a villa culture arose that does not have to shy away from comparison with the founded Wortersee architecture. With its early Middle Ages, Millstatt is not only a peace pole and habitat, but also a scene for art and culture at an international level. Even in tourism, nothing will be left out for chance: the tourist fortunes of the region are long managed by professional adventure drama who create attractions for today's demanding guest. The "on the way in Austria" is the stories and experiences of a summer in a "world of opposites" between the mountain and the lake. / Die Lage zwischen dem Biospharenpark Nockberge, den Hohen Tauern, dem Goldeck und dem Mirnock macht die Region Millstatter See einzigartig. Es ist eine Landschaft voller Mythen und Geschichten, die mit dem Granat einen uralten "Schatz" birgt. An Karntens tiefstem See herrscht ein mildes, fast mediterranes Klima, das schon um die vorletzte Jahrhundertwende Adel und Burgertum anzog und eine Villenkultur entstehen lieSS, die den Vergleich mit der beruhmten Wortherseearchitektur nicht zu scheuen braucht. Mit seinem fruhmittelalterlichen Stift ist Millstatt heute nicht nur ein Ruhepol und Lebensraum, sondern auch ein Schauplatz fur Kunst und Kultur auf internationalem Niveau. Auch im Tourismus wird nichts dem Zufall uberlassen: die touristischen Geschicke der Region werden langst von professionellen Erlebnisdramaturgen gemanagt, die Attraktionen fur den anspruchsvollen Gast von heute kreieren. Das "Unterwegs in Österreich" erzahlt die Geschichten und Erlebnisse eines Sommers in einer "Welt der Gegensatze" zwischen Berg und See.

Harry meets Angelika and Reinhard Ferner in the tonner hut. Both grew up on the hat and returned to their origin after studying or an apprenticeship. Uroma Ermelinda was already on the Alm as a dairy, today the tasks are precisely divided in the family business. Harry's last station is the Gasthof Leitner, and on the way there he passes the Durnberg Moor. In the Gasthof Leitner, Andreas took the management of the Hutte from his parents at the turn of the year. He is the 4th generation that runs the courtyard. During his time abroad, he even cooked for the Norwegian king. / In Grebenzen macht sich Harry Prunster auf die Spur der Via Natura, eines 130 km langen Wanderwegs und beginnt seine Wanderung auf 1.600 Metern Seehohe. Bevor Harry das Grebenzen-Schutzhaus besucht, macht er einen Abstecher zur Wallfahrtskirche Schonanger. Diese wurde 1828 anstelle einer 1736 erbauten Kapelle errichtet. Schutzhaus-Wirt Bernhard Radauer erzahlt Harry die Geschichte der Hutte, die 1988 gebaut wurde und die Harry schon einmal besucht hat. In der Tonnerhutte trifft Harry auf Angelika und Reinhard Ferner. Beide sind auf der Hutte aufgewachsen und nach einem Studium bzw. einer Lehre wieder an ihren Ursprung zuruckgekehrt. Bereits Uroma Ermelinda war als Sennerin auf der Alm, heute sind in dem Familienbetrieb die Aufgaben genau aufgeteilt. Harrys letzte Station istder Gasthof Leitner, und auf dem Weg dorthin kommt er am Durnberger Moor vorbei. Im Gasthof Leitner hat Andreas zum Jahreswechsel die Leitung der Hutte von seinen Eltern ubernommen. Er ist die 4. Generation, die den Hof betreibt. Wahrend seiner Zeit im Ausland hat er sogar fur den norwegischen Konig gekocht.

programme.title: Landleben
programme.desc: In the otherwise tranquil Kaunertal, there is great excitement every five years, because then the large district music festival with 26 chapels takes place in the grass. There are almost more musicians in the valley than people actually live there. The marquee, the moving in the chapels, the barrel tapping, the based on the greater marching competition and the state-related reception of the guardians around their captain Franz keep the locals and visitors trot. In this "country life" production, director Christian Papke accompanies people around this unique festival. While the big music festival is celebrated down in the Kaunertal, life has its own rhythm on the top of the Alm. Matthias Schnegg is hiding his cow on Nasserein-Alm, while his sister Sarah grief for the traditional costumes of the musicians and helps prepare the music festival. At the bottom of the valley, the farmers prepare the hayers and the immudent Otto Kummerts as the way responsible for paths for the road network in the Kaunertal, while Mountain Master Joe Kase-Supplement from Nasserein-Alm. / Im sonst so beschaulichen Kaunertal herrscht alle funf Jahre groSSe Aufregung, denn dann findet in der Grasse das groSSe Bezirksmusikfest mit 26 Kapellen statt. Dabei sind fast mehr Musiker im Tal, als dort eigentlich Menschen leben. Das Festzelt, der Einzug der Kapellen, der Fassanstich, der beruhmt-beruchtigte Marschierwettbewerb und der landesubliche Empfang der Schutzen rund um ihren Hauptmann Franz halten die Einheimischen und die Besucher auf Trab. Regisseur Christian Papke begleitet in dieser "Landleben"-Produktion die Menschen rund um dieses einzigartige Fest. Wahrend unten im Kaunertal das groSSe Musikfest gefeiert wird, hat das Leben oben auf der Alm seinen eigenen Rhythmus. Matthias Schnegg hutet auf der Nasserein-Alm seine Kuhe, wahrend seine Schwester Sarah sich um die Trachten der Musikanten kummert und bei der Vorbereitung des Musikfests hilft. Unten im Tal bereiten die Bauerinnen die Heuernte vor und der unermudliche Otto kummert sich als Wege-Verantwortlicher um das StraSSennetz im Kaunertal, wahrend Bergmeister Joe Kase-Nachschub von der Nasserein-Alm besorgt.

programme.desc: For Christmas, the European Table Tennis Association of the Portuguese capital Lisbon brought the 33rd Team European Championship. 32 teams for men and 33 The women will find themselves in the Meo Arena Lisbons and get in rapid and gripping matches around the team crown of Europe. As the defending champion, Germany goes into the race, which won a total of four of the six fashioned gold medals at the last team European Championship in Schwechat and thus won the title. In addition, the players of the DTTB never cut off worse than third. Eurosport transfers the three decisive competition days of the table tennis team European Championship. / Zu Weihnachten bescherte der Europaische Tischtennisverband der Portugiesischen Hauptstadt Lissabon die Austragung der 33. programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: The documentary format "American Pickers" accompanies the exciting everyday work of the two drods collectors Mike Wolfe and Frank Fritz, who travel across the United States on the hunt for antique shafts. The duo searches mull containers, barns, garages or abandoned houses in order to sell in an apparently worthless scrap in their antiquatate in Iowa profitably. Das Duo durchforstet Mullcontainer, Scheunen, Garagen oder verlassene Hauser, um scheinbar wertlosen Schrott in ihrem Antiquitaten-Geschaft in Iowa gewinnbringend zu verkaufen. programme.desc: A warm day comes to an end. Boats dumped peacefully on the Templiner See. Support: a jet ski hunted over the water, racing directly to a houseboat. Then a shot falls. But the consequences of the crime of Mara to this day: "I have fears, I have to overtake exactly what I do before, where I go, how many people are there, and don't go through the world and spontaneously through my life." Those affected are often advised not to take therapy before the negotiation to appear "authentic" in court. Only after the conviction does she start looking for a therapist. But that is difficult because there are far too few trauma therapists. A few weeks ago the criminal police were with her and informed her that one of the convicts was released. The free of charge is also a bit in it. / "Ein Trauma hat kein Verfallsdatum", sagt Ann-Kristin, die vor zwolf Jahren sexuelle Gewalt erlebt hat. Auch Mara wird Jahre danach immer wieder getriggert. Sie wurde zweimal vergewaltigt.Die heute 26-jahrige Mara diente damals als Zeitsoldatin bei der Bundeswehr. Manner in Uniform losen bei ihr bis heute Panik aus. Ann-Kristin ist inzwischen verheiratet, hat zwei Kinder. Ein normales Leben? Nein. "Die wenigsten sehen, dass es mir schlecht geht."Im Jahr 2024 wurden in Deutschland 13.320 Falle von Vergewaltigung, sexueller Notigung und sexuellem Übergriff im besonders schweren Fall erfasst. Ein Anstieg von 9,3 Prozent im Vergleich zum Vorjahr und ein Anstieg zum sechsten Mal in Folge. Nur etwa jede zehnte Tat taucht uberhaupt im sogenannten Hellfeld auf - also in der polizeilichen Kriminalstatistik. Das besagt die groSSte "Dunkelfeldstudie" in Deutschland, veroffentlicht vom Bundeskriminalamt.Die meisten Vergewaltigungen finden im nahen sozialen Umfeld statt. Gerade wenn der Tater ein Verwandter, Bekannter oder der eigene Lebenspartner ist, erscheint vielen Frauen die Situation aussichtslos. Wie lebt man weiter, wenn die schlimmste Nacht des Lebens nie endet? "37°" erzahlt die Geschichte von zwei Frauen."Nach der Tat hat sich mein Leben komplett um 180 Grad gedreht. Man verandert sein komplettes Wesen, man andert sein komplettes Verhalten, man ist nicht mehr derselbe Mensch", erzahlt Ann-Kristin, die 21 Jahre alt war, als sie von einem Freund vergewaltigt wurde. Die Reaktion ihres Vaters hat sich in ihre Erinnerung gebrannt: "Mit einer der schlimmsten Momente war, als mein Vater den langen Flur im Krankenhaus runterkam, sich so vor meine Beine schmiss. Da wurde mir bewusst, was mir da gerade passiert ist."AbschlieSSen kann Ann-Kristin bis heute nicht. Zwar wurde der Tater verurteilt, doch er ging in Revision und setzte sich ins Ausland ab, wird noch heute mit internationalem Haftbefehl gesucht. Der Gedanke, er konne auftauchen, schurt Ängste. programme.title: Terra x HARRALL LIAL / Terra X Harald Lesch
programme.sub-title: ... and the superpower of the very smallest / ... und die Superkraft des Allerkleinsten
programme.desc: The world of the smallest is the world of quantums. Today's technology is inconceivable without our knowledge. In the future she was even able to revolutionize all of our lives. This year we celebrate 100 years of quantum physics. Harald Lesch explores her meaning at the time. With the Nobel Prize Strager Ferenc Krausz, he explores where to go quantum research - beyond our imagination. Bewage to the 1920s, very young and talented physicists came to the well -known professors of that time. Many based scientists - such as Niels Bohr and Albert Einstein - had already dealt with the council -relevant world of quantums. However, they failed to achieve the breakthrough with the help of the laws of physics. In July 1925, the young Werner Heisenberg finally published his quantum theory. He showed that objects of the atomic world have a "double nature": sometimes they behave as a particle, sometimes like a wave. In between there is a state of the "blurred" in which they can be both - they are quantums. This breathes our everyday experience and imagination. The strange phanomena can only be explained in the very smallest by means of a purely abstract mathematics. Thanks to this knowledge, laser technology, microchips and smartphones could be developed. At Max Planck Institute for Quantum look in Garching, Harald Lesch meets Nobel Prize striker Ferenc Rausz. In 2023 he was awarded the price for physics. He and his team use a special laser technology to develop Hochprazise Blood Analyzes, which are supposed to recognize diseases. The goal is to be able to record the complete molecular composition of a blood sample. So you want to find much more earlier and much more precisely indications of pathological changes. How far is this research? And what does the strange world of quantums have to do with it? With the help of quantum physics, you also research the production of new materials that enable ever smaller and more powerful computers: quantum computers. They overturn the performance even the most strong super calculator by a million times. That also harbors dangers. What if the super computers are used to crack passwords? Even the safest passwords were decided in a fertilizer. No computer would be safe from an attack. And then? Harald Lesch shows that the world of quantums is not just something for specialists. Even if we do not understand them completely, we trace their effect. So that we can continue to accompany the technical developments critically in the future, we have to be able to improve opportunities and risks. We are on the way to new spheres that not only revolutionize medicine and communication, but will also intervene in many other areas of our lives. / Die Welt des Allerkleinsten ist die Welt der Quanten. Die heutige Technik ist ohne unser Wissen daruber nicht denkbar. In der Zukunft konnte sie unser aller Leben sogar revolutionieren.Dieses Jahr feiern wir 100 Jahre Quantenphysik. Harald Lesch erforscht ihre damalige und jetzige Bedeutung. Mit dem Nobelpreistrager Ferenc Krausz erkundet er, wohin uns die Quantenforschung noch fuhren wird - jenseits unserer Vorstellungskraft.Anfang der 1920er Jahre stieSSen sehr junge und begabte Physiker zu den bekannten Professoren dieser Zeit. Viele beruhmte Wissenschaftler - wie Niels Bohr und Albert Einstein - hatten sich bereits mit der ratselhaften Welt der Quanten befasst. Sie scheiterten aber daran, den Durchbruch mithilfe der bis dahin bekannten Gesetze der Physik zu erzielen. Im Juli 1925 veroffentlichte der junge Werner Heisenberg schlieSSlich seine Quantentheorie. Er zeigte, dass Objekte der atomaren Welt eine "Doppelnatur" haben: Mal verhalten sie sich als Teilchen, mal wie eine Welle. Dazwischen gibt es einen Zustand der "Unscharfe", in dem sie beides sein konnen - es sind Quanten. Das sprengt unsere Alltagserfahrung und Vorstellungskraft. Nur mittels rein abstrakter Mathematik lassen sich die seltsamen Phanomene im Allerkleinsten erklaren. Dank dieses Wissens konnte man Lasertechnologie, Mikrochips und auch Smartphones entwickeln.Am Max-Planck-Institut fur Quantenoptik in Garching trifft Harald Lesch den Nobelpreistrager Ferenc Krausz. 2023 wurde er mit dem Preis fur Physik ausgezeichnet. Er und sein Team nutzen eine spezielle Lasertechnologie, um hochprazise Blutanalysen zu entwickeln, die Krankheiten moglichst fruh erkennen sollen. Das Ziel ist, moglichst die komplette molekulare Zusammensetzung einer Blutprobe erfassen zu konnen. So will man viel fruher und viel genauer Hinweise auf krankhafte Veranderungen finden. Wie weit ist diese Forschung bereits? Und was hat die seltsame Welt der Quanten damit zu tun?Mithilfe der Quantenphysik forscht man auch an der Herstellung neuer Materialien, die immer kleinere und leistungsstarkere Rechner ermoglichen: Quantencomputer. Sie ubertreffen die Leistung selbst der starksten herkommlichen Superrechner um ein Millionenfaches. Das birgt auch Gefahren. Was wenn die Superrechner zum Knacken von Passwortern eingesetzt werden? In Sekundenbruchteilen lieSSen sich selbst die sichersten Passworter entschlusseln. Kein Computer ware mehr vor einem Angriff sicher. Und dann?Harald Lesch zeigt, dass die Welt der Quanten nicht nur etwas fur Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten ist. Selbst wenn wir sie nicht komplett verstehen, spuren wir ihre Wirkung. Damit wir auch in Zukunft die technischen Entwicklungen kritisch begleiten konnen, mussen wir in der Lage sein, Chancen und Risiken einzuschatzen. Wir sind auf dem Weg in neue Spharen, die nicht nur die Medizin und Kommunikation revolutionieren, sondern auch in viele weitere Bereiche unseres Lebens eingreifen werden.

"La Maison - Haus der Lust" was created after the bestseller of the same name by Emma Becker, which was also published in Germany in 2020, who was awarded several prizes in France. Becker, born in the Gross area in 1988, processed her own experience in her time in Berlin in her third novel. In the "Stern", but not only there, the novel was enthusiastic: "So Emma Becker forces her audience - sometimes cheeky, sometimes lust, always thoughtful and literary impressive - ultimately with the border and opened a world beyond the well -known clichés." The filmmaker Annissa Bonnefont was first known with documentary films, including about the fashion designer Olivier Rustein from Parisian fashion house Balmain. Almost she had become aware of the project and only came to the train through another director's right. Together with Emma Becker and the leading actress Ana Girardot ("The Wine and the Wind", "Lonely Zweisam"), she developed the script and the main character, not least about the work and the circumstances when shooting the numerous nude scenes: "From the camera tests we worked on the subject of nudity, so that it is never speculative from the start. Sex scene is supposed to say something and advance history. "Ana Girardot actually manages to express the complex motifs of Emmas, also their tornness in dealing with the book project and its very special challenges. In addition to Girardot, the German Hildegard Schroedter ("German House") as brothel manager and Aure Atika ("The Night Manager", "A summer in Provence") and the Almodovar icon Rossy de Palma are represented by further well-known and international female power. / Emma, eine Schriftstellerin, beschlieSSt, ein Buch uber Prostitution zu schreiben - und lernt dabei am eigenen Leib unterschiedlichste Seiten der Arbeit in einem Bordell kennen.Als Emma dem jungen Ian begegnet und von ihrer Sexarbeit erzahlt, stehen beide vor einer kniffeligen Entscheidung. - "La Maison" ist die Verfilmung des aufsehenerregenden Bestsellers der Franzosin Emma Becker, die in ihrem Buch eigene Erfahrungen beschreibt.Die franzosische Schriftstellerin Emma (Ana Girardot) ist 27 und lebt mit ihrer jungeren Schwester Madeleine (Gina Jimenez) in Berlin. Sie fuhrt eine Gelegenheits- und Fernbeziehung mit dem verheirateten Stephane (Yannick Renier), der sie ab und zu in Berlin besucht. Als sie ihm erzahlt, dass sie ein Buch uber Prostitution schreiben und sich deshalb als Prostituierte versuchen mochte, ist er fassungslos. Ihre Schwester nicht weniger. Doch Emma lasst sich nicht abbringen. Das erste Bordell, in dem sie es versucht, ist allerdings kein guter Ort, und schon bald macht sie unliebsame Erfahrungen mit einem unkontrollierbaren Freier.Doch im "La Maison" hat sie mehr Gluck: Dort fuhrt Inge (Hildegard Schroedter) wie eine Mutter Regie und passt auf. Auch ihre Mitarbeiterinnen aus verschiedenen Landern und Milieus gefallen Emma. Eine groSSe Bandbreite von Mannern begegnet ihr: alte, junge, Machos, sexgierige und GenieSSer, aber auch verklemmte und schuchterne Anfanger. Sie erlebt gefahrliche Situationen, Geheimnistuerei und Isolation, aber sie erlebt sich auch als stark und selbstbestimmt. Doch dann lernt sie Ian (Lucas Englander) kennen, verliebt sich in ihn - und steht vor einer kniffeligen Entscheidung."La Maison - Haus der Lust" entstand nach dem 2020 auch in Deutschland erschienenen gleichnamigen Bestseller von Emma Becker, der in Frankreich mit mehreren Preisen ausgezeichnet wurde. Die 1988 im GroSSraum Paris geborene Becker verarbeitete in ihrem dritten Roman eigene Erfahrungen wahrend ihrer Zeit in Berlin. Im "Stern", aber nicht nur dort, wurde der Roman begeistert aufgenommen: "So zwingt Emma Becker ihr Publikum - manchmal frech, manchmal lustern, immer nachdenklich und literarisch eindrucksvoll - letztlich mit uber die Grenze und eroffnet eine Welt jenseits der bekannten Klischees."Die Filmemacherin Annissa Bonnefont war zunachst mit Dokumentarfilmen bekannt geworden, unter anderem uber den Modedesigner Olivier Rousteing vom Pariser Modehaus Balmain. Fast ware sie zu spat auf das Projekt aufmerksam geworden und kam erst durch den Ruckzug eines anderen Regisseurs zum Zug. Gemeinsam mit Emma Becker und der Hauptdarstellerin Ana Girardot ("Der Wein und der Wind", "Einsam Zweisam") entwickelte sie das Drehbuch und die Hauptfigur, wobei es nicht zuletzt um die Arbeit und die Umstande beim Dreh der zahlreichen Nacktszenen ging: "Schon ab den Kamera-Tests arbeiteten wir am Thema Nacktheit, Anas Auftreten, damit sie von Anfang an naturlich ruberkommt. Im Drehbuch ist Nacktheit nie spekulativ, jede Sex-Szene soll etwas sagen und die Geschichte voranbringen."Ana Girardot gelingt es tatsachlich, die komplexen Motive Emmas zum Ausdruck zu bringen, auch ihre Zerrissenheit im Umgang mit dem Buchprojekt und seinen ganz besonderen Herausforderungen. Einer der bestverdienenden deutschen DAX-Manager, Telekom-CEO Timotheus Hottges, erhalt 38.350 Euro - pro Tag.In Norwegen ist diese Lucke deutlich kleiner, und das hat mutmaSSlich einen einfachen Grund: Gehalter sind dort maximal transparent; jede Norwegerin und jeder Norweger kann online das versteuerte Einkommen von allen Landsleuten einsehen, ganz legal und regular. Das heiSSt, jede und jeder in Norwegen kann wissen, dass Ståle Kyllingstad als CEO eines groSSen Öl- und Gaskonzerns in Stavanger rund funf Millionen Euro verdient. "Fur mich ist das kein Problem, das macht mir nichts aus. Wenn Leute hinter meinem Rucken tuscheln, kann ich damit umgehen. Und ehrlich gesagt, es ist mir auch ziemlich egal!"Fakt ist: Noch nie waren die Bedingungen fur Arbeitnehmer und Arbeitnehmerinnen so gut wie jetzt. Der Fachkraftemangel gibt ihnen einen Hebel an die Hand, Firmen mussen sich zunehmend bemuhen, attraktiv zu sein. Und mehr Geld ist ein probates Mittel. 2024 war zudem ein gutes Jahr fur Arbeitnehmerinnen und Arbeitnehmer in Deutschland: Inflationsbereinigt sind die Lohne im Durchschnitt um 3,1 Prozent gestiegen, seit dem 1. Januar 2025 ist auch der gesetzliche Mindestlohn auf 12,82 Euro pro Stunde gestiegen. Davon profitiert etwa Hannelore Jobski, die in Steinhagen, Nordrhein-Westfalen, in einer Reinigungsfiliale arbeitet. "Ich bin seit 25 Jahren in der Branche. Die Arbeit macht mir SpaSS, aber das Geld reicht nur, weil wir in meinem Elternhaus wohnen und keine Miete zahlen mussen."Fakt ist auch: Knapp 30 Prozent der Haushalte verdienen weniger als die sogenannte Mitte, gehoren also zur sogenannten Unterschicht. Es sind Welten, die in diesem Film aufeinanderprallen: Die Telekom-Managerin Simone Carstens jongliert in Bonn Familie und Karriere. Dabei verdient sie sehr gut und ist uberzeugt davon, dass es einfach "einer gewissen Leistung bedarf, um weiterzukommen. Lernen, Disziplin. Also man bekommt nichts geschenkt!" Noch wohlhabender und 30 Jahre alter stimmt Ingrid Hofmann zu. Sie ist Geschaftsfuhrerin einer Zeitarbeitsfirma mit weltweit rund 16.000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern, hat klein angefangen und Karriere gemacht: "Geld ist fur mich umgewandelte Energie.""Ich habe verstanden", sagt Sarah Tacke: "Wer auf dem Niveau arbeitet und Geld verdient, bringt Disziplin, FleiSS und Ehrgeiz mit. Doch was ich mich immer noch frage: Gibt es nicht viele, die genau diese Tugenden auch haben und das Geld nicht verdienen?"In der Dokumentation "Die Wahrheit uber Arbeit und Geld - Was verdient Deutschland" von den Autoren Maik Gizinski und Juliane Kussmann trifft Sarah Tacke in ganz Deutschland und in Norwegen Menschen, die fur ihre Arbeit gleich viel Respekt, aber unterschiedlich viel Geld verdienen.

programme.title: Trugerische Alpenidylle
programme.sub-title: What to do when mountains break away? / Was tun, wenn Berge wegbrechen?
programme.desc: At the end of May, the Swiss village of Blatten will be buried under a huge clash. Not an isolated case: climate change let the Alps brocken. How can people get dirty? Many have already lost their homes due to such disasters - some even their lives. And the risk of mountain storm increases. How do you live in such danger zones? And what does this mean for tourism? On May 28, 2025, nine million cubic meters of rock and ice on blatings in Swiss Valais. The small mountain village is buried under a rubble pile of more than two kilometers long and more than 100 meters high. A man is killed, around 300 villagers can be brought to safety, but lose their home and not infrequently their economic existence. How did it come about? Can and is supposed to be rebuilt? The Blatten catastrophe is part of a sequence of unf -icing that the Alpine region has already hit. Bondo in Switzerland, for example, was destroyed in August 2017. Eight hikers died in the roller masses. For years, Bondo was rebuilt and protected by protective measures: Damme and new bridges were built and the back holding basin for Murgange was expanded. Can this be overwhelmed? Are the dangers banned? As part of the necessary protective measures, monitoring the dangerous mountain slope plays a special role. A project of the TU Munchen shows how this works that has been overhauling the Hochvogel in the Oberallgau for years. In Kandersteg, intensive surveillance is rely on intensive surveillance. Here the next landlord threatens and the village center is in the middle of the danger zone. What is intended for the security of the residents also turns out to be a bastow apple. Because the classification keeps the tourists away and quite a few residents therefore defend themselves. The documentary not only describes the catastrophic developments and the scientific background. She focuses primarily on people: the residents, for whom the Alps are a home, but also an economic livelihood. For tourists who love the natural area and have to implement the local politicians who have to implement crisis management and future planning. / Ende Mai wird das Schweizer Dorf Blatten unter einem riesigen Bergsturz begraben. Kein Einzelfall: Der Klimawandel lasst die Alpen brockeln. Wie konnen sich die Menschen schutzen?Viele haben durch solche Katastrophen schon ihre Heimat verloren - manche sogar ihr Leben. Und das Risiko fur Bergsturze steigt. Wie lebt man in solchen Gefahrenzonen? Und was bedeutet das fur den Tourismus?Am 28. Mai 2025 sturzen neun Millionen Kubikmeter Fels und Eis auf Blatten im Schweizer Wallis. Das kleine Bergdorf wird unter einem mehr als zwei Kilometer langen und mehr als 100 Meter hohen Schutthaufen begraben. Ein Mann kommt ums Leben, etwa 300 Dorfbewohnerinnen und -bewohner konnen zwar in Sicherheit gebracht werden, verlieren aber ihr Zuhause und nicht selten ihre wirtschaftliche Existenz. Wie ist es dazu gekommen? Kann und soll der Ort wieder aufgebaut werden?Die Katastrophe von Blatten reiht sich ein in eine Abfolge von Unglucken, die die Alpenregion bereits heimgesucht haben. Bondo in der Schweiz etwa wurde im August 2017 zerstort. Acht Wanderer starben in den Gerollmassen. Jahrelang wurde Bondo wieder aufgebaut und durch SchutzmaSSnahmen abgesichert: Damme und neue Brucken wurden errichtet und das Ruckhaltebecken fur Murgange erweitert.Lasst sich das auf Blatten ubertragen? Sind die Gefahren damit gebannt? Im Rahmen der notwendigen SchutzmaSSnahmen spielt die Überwachung der gefahrdeten Berghange eine besondere Rolle. Wie das funktioniert, zeigt ein Projekt der TU Munchen, das den Hochvogel im Oberallgau seit Jahren uberwacht.In Kandersteg setzt man auf intensive Überwachung. Hier droht der nachste Bergsturz und das Dorfzentrum liegt mitten in der Gefahrenzone. Was fur die Sicherheit der Bewohner gedacht ist, entpuppt sich aber auch als Zankapfel. Denn die Einstufung halt die Touristen fern und nicht wenige Einwohner setzen sich deshalb dagegen zur Wehr.Welche Losungen gibt es also fur den sich verandernden Lebensraum Alpen? Die Doku schildert nicht nur die katastrophalen Entwicklungen und die wissenschaftlichen Hintergrunde. Sie legt den Fokus vor allem auf die Menschen: die Einwohner, fur die die Alpen ein Zuhause, aber auch eine wirtschaftliche Lebensgrundlage sind. Fur die Touristen, die den Naturraum lieben und die Lokalpolitiker, die Krisenmanagement und Zukunftsplanung umsetzen mussen.

programme.title: Dnevna soba
programme.desc: Riječ je o emisiji Zabavnog programa, koja će pokušati da savjetuje i razonodi gledaoce. Želja je da se u sat i po gledaoci relaksiraju i zabave, kako bi pobjegli od dnevnih problema. Namijenjena je svim generacijama i porodici. U brojnim rubrikama bavimo se zanimljivim i aktuelnim temama, a uz pomoć sagovornika dijelimo savjete za jednostavniji život. Uz jednostavne i konkretne savjete za gledaoce, u emisiji ćemo ugostiti brojne individualce ili grupe koje se bave humanitarnim radom, kao i poznate ličnosti koje ćemo predstavljati u nešto drugačijem svjetlu, pružiti im mogućnost da sa gledaocima dijele svoja životna iskustva i male tajne u funkcionisanju domaćinstva.

programme.title: Dnevna soba
programme.desc: Riječ je o emisiji Zabavnog programa, koja će pokušati da savjetuje i razonodi gledaoce. Želja je da se u sat i po gledaoci relaksiraju i zabave, kako bi pobjegli od dnevnih problema. Namijenjena je svim generacijama i porodici. U brojnim rubrikama bavimo se zanimljivim i aktuelnim temama, a uz pomoć sagovornika dijelimo savjete za jednostavniji život. Uz jednostavne i konkretne savjete za gledaoce, u emisiji ćemo ugostiti brojne individualce ili grupe koje se bave humanitarnim radom, kao i poznate ličnosti koje ćemo predstavljati u nešto drugačijem svjetlu, pružiti im mogućnost da sa gledaocima dijele svoja životna iskustva i male tajne u funkcionisanju domaćinstva.

programme.title: Alo Alo
programme.desc: Francuska, II Svjetski rat. Rene Artoa je vlasnik malog kafea, sa nesvakidašnjim mukama. U njegovom malom kafeu se sastaje bulumenta raznih likova, od boraca francuskog pokreta otpora, preko oficira Gestapoa i njemačkih vojnika do britanskih padobranaca. Svi oni pokušavaju da ne budu otkriveni u svojim namjerama, dok se Rene trudi da ga tašta i žena ne otkriju u aferama sa konobaricama.

programme.desc: Ljubav spaja dvoje ljudi. Nakon vjenčanja spaja se i ono što su oni već imali - a, to su njihova djeca. Jedna od najgledanijih španskih serija, svih vremena. Koktel smijeha, ljubavi i optimizma koji nastaje spajanjem naizgled nespojivog.

programme.title: Lokalni hodači
programme.desc: Spajajući svoje profesinalne vještine (Ivana je politikološkinja, Ivan audio-video stvaralac) i lična interesovanja sa zadovoljstvom odlaska na odabrane lokacije, vremenom su putem digitalnih servisa i društvenih mreža sa širom javnošću počeli da dijele svoje zapise i naišli na opšte oduševljenje i podršku. Zahvaljujući njihovim kratkim putopisnim klipovima u "vlog" formi, mnogima od nas otkrili su nove staze za šetnju, a posjeta stranicama s njihovim sadržajem predstavlja savršenu brošuru za lokalce i turiste koji traže alternative popularnim i prenagužvanim izletištima. Ivana i Ivan publici se obraćaju jezikom oslobođenim forme, jednostavno, prijateljski i često koristeći lokalni "sleng" govor, ali bez nepristojnih ili uvredljivih izraza.

programme.title: Qualifying - F1 Academy - F1 ACAD - Zandvoort Round
programme.desc: The qualifying session at Zandvoort will set the tone for the weekend, with the fight for pole between Doriane Pin, Chloe Chambers, and Marta García expected to be intense. The circuit’s narrow layout and fast, sweeping turns leave little margin for error, putting a premium on precision and car control. With grid position often decisive at this track, pole could be the difference between victory and defeat in both races of Round 5.

programme.title: Race 1 - F1 Academy - F1 ACAD - Zandvoort Round
programme.desc: The opening 17-lap sprint of Round 5 is set to be a high-pressure contest where starts and first-corner battles may decide the order. Doriane Pin looks to extend her lead in the standings, but Chloe Chambers and Marta García are poised to strike. Tire management and avoiding track-limit penalties will be key on the demanding Zandvoort layout. The result will shape momentum heading into Sunday’s second sprint.

programme.title: Race 2 - F1 Academy - F1 ACAD - Zandvoort Round
programme.desc: The second sprint race closes out the Zandvoort weekend with another 17-lap duel. With double opportunities for points across the two races, championship leader Doriane Pin must balance aggression with caution, while her rivals see this as the chance to narrow the gap. Zandvoort’s technical corners and high-risk overtaking zones raise the stakes, ensuring the round ends with tension and championship drama.

programme.title: Main Race - FIA Formula 1 World Championship - Dutch GP - 2025
programme.desc: The 15th race of the season unfolds at Zandvoort, with McLaren dominating the standings: Piastri (284 pts), Norris (275), Verstappen (187). McLaren lead constructors by a landslide. Narrow streets and high-speed corners mean strategy and qualifying are key. Expect fireworks in this clutch championship battle.

programme.title: Sprint Race - Hungary GP - Moto GP - 2025
programme.desc: The Tissot Sprint brings half-distance racing at full intensity. Thirteen laps of Balaton Park test riders with little time to recover mistakes. Points go to the top nine finishers (12-9-7-6-5-4-3-2-1), making every position count in the championship. Expect lightning starts, bold overtakes into the heavy braking zones, and a frantic dash to the flag as riders fight for momentum heading into the Grand Prix.

programme.title: Main Race - Hungary GP - Moto GP - 2025
programme.desc: The Hungarian Grand Prix main event delivers 26 laps, covering more than 105 km of pure racing action. The technical nature of Balaton Park punishes tyre wear and rewards consistent pace, making pit-wall strategy and rider discipline essential. Championship points for the top 15 are on offer, from 25 for the winner downward. Expect wheel-to-wheel fights, decisive braking moves, and a podium that could reshape the title battle.

programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. programme.desc: The well-known author of the game about games, Sara Miljković, in the world of games known as Sarezza, is represented by Stumble Guys. In this game 32 players on the network race, jump and chase to the goal, until the best win the crown. / Poznata autorka videozapisa o igrama, Sara Miljković, u svetu igara poznata kao Sarezza, predstavlja nam Stumble Guys. U ovoj igri 32 igrača na mreži trkaju se, skaču i jure do cilja, sve dok najbolji ne osvoji krunu.

programme.title: Kidarena - Tasteless Rocket League
programme.desc: We take you to the world of hybrid football in which a player is operating a car that strives to control the ball greater than yourself. The goal of the game is, as in football, score. / Vodimo vas u svet hibridnog fudbala u kome igrač upravlja automobilom koji nastoji da kontroliše loptu veću od sebe. Cilj igre je, kao i u fudbalu, postići gol.

programme.title: Retro Migz1 - Nfs Most Wanted
programme.desc: We return to 2005. year and we recall the ninth part of the popular franchise Need for Speed. Over the years, this continuation has gained a cult status and a large number of fans. / Vraćamo se u 2005. godinu i prisećamo se devetog dela popularne franšize Need for Speed. Tokom godina, upravo ovaj nastavak je stekao kultni status i veliki broj fanova.

programme.title: Kidarena - Tkdspale - Fortnite Racing
programme.desc: Follow the clip of the adrenaline race and enjoy the speed of the best cars! / Pratite isečak adrenalinske trke i uživajte u brzini najboljih automobila!

programme.title: Sarezza Minecraft: Season 2 / Sarezza Minecraft: Sezona 2
programme.desc: The show is intended for all the MINECRAFT GAMES. Discover numerous secrets and tricks to help you improve your skills in playing this game! / Emisija namenjena svim ljubiteljima igrice Minecraft. Otkrijte brojne tajne i trikove koji će vam pomoći da unapredite svoje veštine u igranju ove igrice!

programme.title: Kidarena - Migzi Maus - Disney Epic Mickey
programme.desc: We try out a game that was published in 2010. years and inspired by the magical division world. The famous MIKA MAUS, but also the Osvald, a rabbit, which was the main hero of Disney films before the appearance of the legendary mouse. / Isprobavamo igricu koja je objavljena 2010. godine i inspirisana je čarobnim Diznijevim svetom. U igrici se pojavljuje čuveni Miki Maus, ali i Osvald, zec koji je bio glavni junak Diznijevih filmova pre pojave legendarnog miša.

programme.title: Profesor Babic - The Elder Scrolls Iv: Oblivion
programme.desc: Review popular action game published in 2006. years. The fourth sequel in the players series brings the opportunity to enter the world full of magic in which they must fight against notorious mitological beings. / Recenzija popularne akcijske igrice koja je objavljena 2006. godine. Četvrti nastavak u serijalu igračima donosi priliku da uđu u svet pun magije u kom moraju da se bore protiv ozloglašenih mitoloških bića.

programme.title: Arkadne Legende - Cold Heart and Snake
programme.desc: Go with us on a trip to the past and remember some legendary arcade games! / Pođite sa nama na putovanje u prošlost i prisetite se nekih legendarnih arkadnih igara!

programme.title: Kada Migzi Postane Senka - Assassins Creed Shadows
programme.desc: We bring you a review of the game that has been published in March 2025. year and is part of the popular Franchise Assassins Creed. programme.title: Kidarena - Sarezza Roblox

programme.title: Basketball - KLS: Mega - FMP / Košarka - KLS: Mega - FMP
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Porto - Manchester United
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Paris - Fenerbahce, G3
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Partizan - Borac / Košarka - ABA liga: Partizan - Borac
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Dinastija
programme.desc: The mighty oil mogul Blake Carrington is preparing for a wedding with Young KRYSTLE JENNINGS, his former secretary. Her only ally is Black's son, Steven, who, however, does not understand with her father, because of his different political views. / Mogočen naftni mogotec Blake Carrington se pripravlja na poroko z mlado Krystle Jennings, svojo nekdanjo tajnico. Čeprav je predan Krystle, Blake veliko več časa in pozornosti namenja svojemu podjetju Denver-Carrington, zato niti ne opazi, s čim vse se Krystle sooča. programme.desc: Open the treasure trove of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer surrenders together with interesting guests on the show Chat Ob coffee. programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, first League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, first League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

We will talk about the importance of determining time before the screens when it comes to child's health, the importance of music education and enrollment in music schools, as well as how to choose the right school bag for a healthy spine. Finally, some nostalgia: how do famous Slovenes remember the first school day? Former ski jumper Price Prevc, writer Primož Suhodolčan and singer Zala Smolnikar will evoke their memories and anecdotes. Also Monday morning on TV SLO Monika Tavčar and Andrej Hofer. / Začenja se novo šolsko leto, zato bomo govorili o šolstvu – nekoč in danes, skozi številke, zgodbe, izkušnje in nasvete. Posvetili se bomo tako otrokom kot staršem, pa tudi zdravju, obšolskim dejavnostim in pripravam na prvi šolski dan. Dotaknili se bomo tudi vloge staršev v šolskem sistemu in razmislili, kje so meje njihovega vpliva? Govorili bomo o pomenu določanja časa pred zasloni, ko gre za otrokovo zdravje, o pomenu glasbene vzgoje in vpisu v glasbene šole, pa tudi o tem, kako izbrati pravo šolsko torbo za zdravo hrbtenico. Za konec pa še nekaj nostalgije: kako se prvega šolskega dne spominjajo znani Slovenci? Svoje spomine in anekdote bodo obujali nekdanji smučarski skakalec Cene Prevc, pisatelj Primož Suhodolčan in pevka Zala Smolnikar. Pa tudi voditelja ponedeljkovega jutra na TV SLO Monika Tavčar in Andrej Hofer.

programme.title: Matija Vertovec, Great Mind of the Slovenian nation, documentary, Mon. / Matija Vertovec, veliki um slovenskega naroda, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Naberšnik Marko ... Matija Vertovec was a priest, chemist, geographer, historian, starter, preacher, polyglot and the first teacher of Slovenian winegrowers. / R: Naberšnik Marko... Matija Vertovec je bil duhovnik, kemik, geograf, zgodovinar, zvezdoslovec, pridigar, poliglot in prvi učitelj slovenskih vinogradnikov.
programme.desc: He was the great mind of the Slovenian nation and the folk teacher from the beginning of the 19th century, whose teachings are still very topical after 200 years. What is his heritage, the three theologians and a young priest are discovered, who embark on the path of research with the only preserved Vertovec photo. Yet the documentary is not a reconstruction of the life of a portrait. The narrative is based on a picture of modern times, which through the stories of the main protagonists becomes so alive that it offers us an insight into the time of Matija Vertovec. In addition to the lead biographical story, the documentary at the same time detects the priesthood profession, and the young researchers meet with Vertovc's relatives, locals and experts who each continue their work of the great man. Few people know that Matija Vertovec was the one who addressed Prešeren to Zdravljica's record and encouraged Peter Kozlar to produce a map of Slovenian lands. He was the first to write in Slovene about viticulture and cellar, about useful chemistry, astronomy and general world history. He informed the locals across the Vipava Valley about the benefits of vaccination over black goats, thus defending them against death. He agreed with the French authorities and saved Vipava's payments of high taxes, he was a man of practical exploration, and unlike most priests of his time, who were inserting from the pulpit, he went to compatriots and invested a lot of energy into the education of simple people. / Bil je veliki um slovenskega naroda in ljudski učitelj z začetka 19. stoletja, čigar nauki so po 200 letih še vedno zelo aktualni. Kakšna je njegova dediščina, odkrivajo trije bogoslovci in mlad duhovnik, ki se na pot raziskovanja odpravijo z edino ohranjeno Vertovčevo fotografijo. Pa vendar dokumentarni film ni rekonstrukcija življenja portretiranca. Pripoved temelji na sliki sodobnega časa, ki skozi zgodbe glavnih protagonistov postane tako živa, da nam ponuja vpogled v čas Matije Vertovca. Dokumentarni film poleg vodilne biografske zgodbe hkrati detabuizira duhovniški poklic, mladi raziskovalci pa se srečajo z Vertovčevimi sorodniki, domačini in strokovnjaki, ki vsak po svoje nadaljujejo delo velikega človeka. Le malokdo ve, da je bil prav Matija Vertovec tisti, ki je Prešerna nagovoril k zapisu Zdravljice, Petra Kozlarja pa vzpodbudil k izdelavi Zemljevida slovenskih dežel. Bil je prvi, ki je v slovenskem jeziku pisal o vinogradništvu in kletarjenju, o uporabni kemiji, o astronomiji in o splošni svetovni zgodovini. Domačine širom Vipavske doline je informiral o prednostih cepljenja pred črnimi kozami in jih tako ubranil pred smrtjo. S francosko oblastjo se je pogodil in Vipavce rešil plačevanja visokih davkov, bil je človek praktičnega raziskovanja, za razliko od večine duhovnikov njegovega časa, ki so žugali s prižnice, pa je hodil med rojake in veliko energije vložil v izobraževanje preprostih ljudi.

programme.desc: The documentary is designed as a tribute to the human spirit and the desire to change with the power of one's own will. The story is an inspiring personal portrait and offers the answer to the question of how to regulate a person's attitude towards the mountain world. The message of the film shows that the solution is in a sustainable stay that takes into account the living space of all living things. Or, as Irena Mrak says, "If you can observe, you can also respect!". / Dokumentarec je zastavljen kot poklon človeškemu duhu in želji po spremembah z močjo lastne volje. Zgodba je navdihujoč osebni portret in ponuja odgovor na vprašanje, kako urediti odnos človeka do gorskega sveta. Sporočilo filma kaže, da je rešitev v sonaravnem bivanju, ki upošteva življenjski prostor vseh živih bitij. Ali kot pravi Irena Mrak: »Če znaš opazovati, znaš tudi spoštovati!«.

programme.desc: Rashid Kan Mazed, who is called the phrases of Kan, is the Bangladec Rap musician, Muslim, who lives in Čatak. In his poems, he talks about burning social topics: rapes, sexual assaults, patriarchality in rural areas and institutionalized violence. Rapanje is an art for him, through which he can express his opinion, encourage people and raise awareness of social problems. It strongly attacks the ruling who abuse power and suppress people, although his actions are risky. He is often warned to stop and threaten him. But the phrases are unwaveringly raped forward and inspires the overwhelmed crowds. Celia is a French artist who has Malagasy ancestors. While finding answers to questions about her identity, she moved to azore, where she discovered a whole new range of colors as a painter. He is now trying to obtain a permit for Mural, which she would like to dedicate to this beautiful island and island residents. Saso Dudic is a tattooist, mountain rescuer, musician. Each activity shows a part of his struggle with fears and a pursuit of growth of self -esteem and for acceptance. Tries to open a discussion of mental health. Will people listen? / Rašid Kan Mazed, ki mu pravijo Fraze Kan, je bangladeški rapovski glasbenik, musliman, ki živi v Čataku. V svojih pesmih govori o žgočih družbenih temah: posilstvih, spolnih napadih, patriarhalnosti na podeželju in institucionaliziranem nasilju. Rapanje je zanj umetnost, skozi katero lahko izrazi svoje mnenje, spodbuja ljudi in jih ozavešča o družbenih problemih. Ostro napada vladajoče, ki zlorabljajo oblast in zatirajo ljudi, čeprav je njegovo početje tvegano. Pogosto ga svarijo, naj preneha, in mu grozijo. A Fraze neomajno rapa naprej in navdihuje preslišane množice.Celia je francoska umetnica, ki ima malgaške prednike. Med iskanjem odgovorov na vprašanja o svoji identiteti se je preselila na Azore, kjer je kot slikarka odkrila povsem novo paleto barv. Zdaj skuša pridobiti dovoljenje za mural, ki bi ga rada posvetila temu čudovitemu otočju in otoškim prebivalcem. Sašo Dudić je tetovator, gorski reševalec, glasbenik. Vsaka dejavnost prikazuje del njegovega boja s strahovi ter prizadevanje za rast samozavesti in za sprejetost. Poskuša odpreti razpravo o duševnem zdravju. Bodo ljudje prisluhnili?

programme.title: Worldwide: Marky Ramone - penultimate Ramona, Mon. / Svetovno: Marky Ramone – predzadnji Ramone, pon.
programme.desc: When Marc Steven Bell was invited to the Ramones Brotherhood in 1978, his artistic biography already stated that it belongs to "an empty generation." This is how Marky Ramone appeared and, on the album Road to Ruin, for half a year later, proved that he quickly won all the "1-2-3-4" elements. He overwhelmed for 15 years in the band and recorded 8 studio albums, and today, with his band Blitzkrieg, evokes memories of a band that was inspired by everyone, but no one knew how to imitate it. / Ko je bil Marc Steven Bell leta 1978 povabljen v bratovščino Ramones, je v njegovem umetniškem življenjepisu že pisalo, da pripada »prazni generaciji.« Prehod med dvema setoma bobnov zanj ni bil težak, le v skladu s pravili bratovščine si je moral izbrati novo ime. Tako se je pojavil Marky Ramone in na albumu Road to Ruin že dobrega pol leta kasneje dokazal, da je hitro osvojil vse »1-2-3-4« prvine. V skupini je previharil 15 let ter z njo posnel 8 studijskih albumov, danes pa s svojo skupino Blitzkrieg obuja spomine na skupino, po kateri so se zgledovali vsi, nihče pa je ni znal posnemati.

programme.desc: The "countrymen" broadcast is a bridge between the homeland and the Slovenes living outside its borders. The poem, literature, folklore and many other forms of expression preserve the living Slovene word and tradition. Slovenianness also lives on thanks to new economic integrations, research and tourist initiatives and outstanding individuals who enrich our common space. All of these are compatriots, get to know them with us. / Oddaja »Rojaki« je most med domovino in Slovenci, ki živijo zunaj njenih meja. Pesem, literatura, folklora in številne druge oblike izražanja ohranjajo živo slovensko besedo in tradicijo. Slovenstvo živi naprej tudi po zaslugi novih gospodarskih povezovanj, raziskovalnih in turističnih pobud ter izjemnih posameznikov, ki bogatijo naš skupen prostor. programme.title: Herbalism - Heritage and Inspiration, Post on Culture, Mon. / Zeliščarstvo – dediščina in navdih, oddaja o kulturi, pon.
programme.desc: Herbalism is one of the oldest forms of human activity in the natural environment, as people have always been aware that plants can also be used for medicinal purposes. It is part of folk medicine and comprises experiential knowledge of the way herbs are harvested, drying and processed for food and cosmetic purposes. Although knowledge has changed a lot over time, herbalism remains present and popular, and since 2022 it has been entered as a living heritage in the register of intangible cultural heritage. Due to accessibility, color and diversity, herbs are also inspiration for many artists who use and depict them in their works in a variety of ways and we will present some of them in the show. / Zeliščarstvo je ena najstarejših oblik človekove dejavnosti v naravnem okolju, saj so se ljudje že od nekdaj zavedali, da lahko rastline uporabijo tudi v zdravilne namene. Je del ljudske medicine in obsega izkustveno znanje o načinu nabiranja, sušenja in predelavi zelišč v prehrambno-zdravilne in kozmetične namene. Čeprav se je znanje skozi čas zelo spreminjalo, zeliščarstvo ostaja prisotno in priljubljeno, od leta 2022 pa je kot živa dediščina vpisano tudi v Register nesnovne kulturne dediščine. Zaradi dostopnosti, barvitosti in raznolikosti pa so zelišča navdih tudi za mnoge umetnike, ki jih pri svojih delih uporabljajo in upodabljajo na kar najrazličnejše načine in nekatere med njimi bomo predstavili v oddaji.

programme.title: Environments, pom. / Ambienti, pon.
programme.sub-title: Not far from Ljubljana, a few years ago, a new house has grown, which was created by "remote". The owners were absent during design and construction, so that they were monitoring their new home only from afar, through audio and video links. I / Nedaleč od Ljubljane je pred nekaj leti zrasla nova hiša, ki je nastala tako rekoč »na daljavo«. Lastnika sta bila med projektiranjem in gradnjo odsotna, tako da sta nastajanje njunega novega doma spremljala samo od daleč, prek avdio in video povezav. I
programme.desc: When building or renovating a home, we create not only a building, but a place where we will spend valuable moments with our loved ones, where our children will grow and where memories and traditions that will form future generations will be created. Sustainable construction allows us to design our environment in a responsible, lasting and healthy way. We explain how we can achieve this. The offsets that affected a large part of Slovenia last August were destroyed by many. The powerful power of water paved the way between the living spaces of unsuspecting people who tried to save what could be solved. The ground floor of a row house was also heavily destroyed in the floods, but thanks to the exemplary cooperation between the interior designer and the owners, it today draws smiles and satisfaction on the face of everyone involved. / Ko gradimo ali prenavljamo dom, ne ustvarjamo zgolj stavbe, ampak prostor, kjer bomo preživljali dragocene trenutke s svojimi najbližjimi, kjer bodo naši otroci rasli in kjer bodo nastajali spomini in tradicije, ki bodo oblikovali prihodnje generacije. Trajnostna gradnja nam omogoča, da oblikujemo naše okolje na odgovoren, trajen in zdrav način. Razložimo, kako lahko to dosežemo.Poplave, ki so avgusta lani prizadele velik del Slovenije, so marsikomu uničile dom. Silna moč vode si je utirala pot med bivalnimi prostori nič hudega slutečih ljudi, ki so skušali rešiti, kar se je rešiti dalo. Tudi pritličje vrstne hiše je bilo v poplavah močno uničeno, a po zaslugi zglednega sodelovanja med oblikovalko interjerja ter lastnikoma, dandanes riše nasmehe in zadovoljstvo na obraz vsem vpletenim.

programme.title: Miss Scarlet and the Duke
programme.desc: When an intimate friend of Mr. Potts appears murdered, Leliza is investigating the dark and macabre world of the Victorian funeral home. The victim, Theobald Turner, was the enemy and rival of Mr. Hardcastle, Lamo of the main company of Pompes Funerals in London. / Quan un amic íntim del senyor Potts apareix assassinat, lEliza es troba investigant el mon fosc i macabre de les funeràries victorianes. La víctima, Theobald Turner, era enemic i rival del senyor Hardcastle, lamo de la principal empresa de pompes fúnebres de Londres.

programme.title: Vienna Blood
programme.sub-title: The queen of the night. First part / La reina de la noche. Primera parte
programme.desc: Four women are dead in a vienna brothel in the midst of a blood, but one of the corpses was washed and placed on a kind. Linspector Rheinhardt soon finds a man who looks like the ideal culprit, but Dr. Liebermann is not clear. / En un bordell de Viena apareixen mortes quatre dones enmig duna sangada, però un dels cadàvers lhan rentat i col·locat sobre una mena daltar. Linspector Rheinhardt aviat troba un home que sembla el culpable ideal, però el doctor Liebermann no ho veu clar.

programme.title: Vienna Blood
programme.sub-title: The queen of the night. Second / La reina de la noche. Segunda parte
programme.desc: Dr. Liebermann discovers a racist secret organization and believes that one of its members is Lassassí who kills immigrants in Vienna, but does not find evidence to demonstrate. Clara, her promise, wants to help her solve the case. / El doctor Liebermann descobreix una organitzacio secreta racista i creu que un dels seus membres es lassassí que mata immigrants a Viena, però no troba proves que ho demostrin. programme.title: Asesinatos del norte
programme.desc: Sandra Schwartenbeck is accidentally struggling during the work of her home, so it will be in Lars Englen who will accompany Finn Kieseawetter in the new case, which takes them to the farmer's farm Gerhard Anderson. / La Sandra Schwartenbeck sha grapat el peu accidentalment durant les obres de casa seva, així que serà en Lars Englen qui acompanyarà en Finn Kiesewetter en el nou cas, que els porta a la finca del fabricant darmes Gerhard Anderson.

programme.title: Asesinatos del norte
programme.desc: A great shot is lived in the port of Lubeck: The crew of an anti -adornment ship has rescued a body of water. There is no doubt that the victim has been killed. This is Benny Kerber, the Olympic and a member of the local nautical club. / Es viu una gran commocio al port de Lubeck: la tripulacio dun vaixell antiincendis ha rescatat un cos de laigua. No hi ha dubte que la víctima ha sigut assassinada. Es tracta den Benny Kerber, lesperança olímpica i membre del club nàutic local.

programme.title: Catch if you can summer: episode 55 / Atrapam si pots estiu: Episodi 55
programme.desc: This year, the program catches if you can also take place during the summer. The presenter Llucià Ferrer also leads this edition. programme.desc: Daily news that collects the most prominent events in Catalan, state and international. programme.title: No FICCIO: Luke, a chronicle of pastry / Sense ficcio: Lluc, una crònica de la pastisseria
programme.desc: Lluc Crusellas is a Catalan baker who, at the age of twenty-six, has been the most important challenge of his career: winning the World Chocolate Masters and becoming a chocolate master. / En Lluc Crusellas es un pastisser català que, amb vint-i-sis anys, senfronta al desafiament mes important de la seva carrera: guanyar el World Chocolate Masters i convertir-se en mestre xocolater.

programme.title: Sense Ficcio: Merckx, Race of a Champion / Sense ficcio: Merckx, race of a champion
programme.desc: From 1967 to 1975, in just a decade, Eddy Merckx won everything. This film tells the greatness and setbacks of an iconic figure of world cycling. This documentary captures the splendor years of one of the best cyclists in history. Through an extensive archive material, "Merckx: the cannibal of cycling" reviews the life of the Belgian, from its humble ascent and its first competitions to its international triumphs. The documentary also does not avoid the difficult moments of his career, such as the positive in an anti -doping control just when he prepared to fulfill his dream of conquering the Tour of France. After this blow, Merckx recovers, as he would do it throughout his career, facing accidents and adversities. More than the portrait of a champion, this documentary is an inspiring history of resilience: that of a man who never surrenders. / De 1967 a 1975, en apenas una decada, Eddy Merckx lo gano todo. Esta película narra la grandeza y los reveses de una figura iconica del ciclismo mundial.Adorado y luego cuestionado por el público, Eddy Merckx se convirtio en uno de los grandes heroes del deporte. Este documental captura los años de esplendor de uno de los mejores ciclistas de la historia. A traves de un extenso material de archivo, “Merckx: el caníbal del ciclismo” repasa la vida del belga, desde su humilde ascenso y sus primeras competiciones hasta sus triunfos internacionales. El documental tampoco elude los momentos difíciles de su carrera, como el positivo en un control antidopaje justo cuando se preparaba para cumplir su sueño de conquistar el Tour de Francia. Tras este golpe, Merckx se recupera, como lo haría a lo largo de toda su carrera, enfrentando accidentes y adversidades.Más que el retrato de un campeon, este documental es una inspiradora historia de resiliencia: la de un hombre que nunca se rinde.

programme.title: No FICCIO: Purunga, The Home of the Cliff / Sense ficcio: Purunga, lhome dels penya-segats

programme.title: Sense Ficcio: Merckx, Race of a Champion / Sense ficcio: Merckx, race of a champion
programme.desc: From 1967 to 1975, in just a decade, Eddy Merckx won everything. This film tells the greatness and setbacks of an iconic figure of world cycling. This documentary captures the splendor years of one of the best cyclists in history. Through an extensive archive material, "Merckx: the cannibal of cycling" reviews the life of the Belgian, from its humble ascent and its first competitions to its international triumphs. The documentary also does not avoid the difficult moments of his career, such as the positive in an anti -doping control just when he prepared to fulfill his dream of conquering the Tour of France. After this blow, Merckx recovers, as he would do it throughout his career, facing accidents and adversities. More than the portrait of a champion, this documentary is an inspiring history of resilience: that of a man who never surrenders. / De 1967 a 1975, en apenas una decada, Eddy Merckx lo gano todo. Esta película narra la grandeza y los reveses de una figura iconica del ciclismo mundial.Adorado y luego cuestionado por el público, Eddy Merckx se convirtio en uno de los grandes heroes del deporte. Este documental captura los años de esplendor de uno de los mejores ciclistas de la historia. A traves de un extenso material de archivo, “Merckx: el caníbal del ciclismo” repasa la vida del belga, desde su humilde ascenso y sus primeras competiciones hasta sus triunfos internacionales. El documental tampoco elude los momentos difíciles de su carrera, como el positivo en un control antidopaje justo cuando se preparaba para cumplir su sueño de conquistar el Tour de Francia. Tras este golpe, Merckx se recupera, como lo haría a lo largo de toda su carrera, enfrentando accidentes y adversidades.Más que el retrato de un campeon, este documental es una inspiradora historia de resiliencia: la de un hombre que nunca se rinde.
